hf.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
hf.abstract: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. A key insight is that tasks with different modalities and surface forms can share the same underlying capability requirements. We therefore introduce The Trinity, a recursive self-improvement framework coupling world generation with Harness evolution through three roles: Creator, Explorer, and Evolver. Drawing on verified execution trajectories, Evolver shifts the basis of task organization from surface categories to shared requirements, reorganizing the original task tree into a hierarchical capability tree. We introduce Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real: for heterogeneous tasks at the same node, Creator abstracts their common requirements into simplified, verifiable simulated worlds for capability learning, while evaluation on original tasks measures transfer. Along this capability tree, Explorer progressively evolves reusable capability modules through selective inheritance, forming a Harness tree whose validated updates accumulate across iterations within a fixed topology. The resulting Harnesses specialize in different capabilities, motivating a Capability-Aware Harness Router that uses public task information to select compatible module configurations from the tree. Our evolved Harnesses improve mean performance by 34 points across 28 training benchmarks and 26 points across 18 unseen benchmarks, including two real-world embodied tasks.
hf.titleZh: The Trinity：能力驱动的多模态智能体递归自我改进
hf.summaryZh: 针对异构可验证环境构造成本高、人工迭代Harness跟不上任务多样性这两个瓶颈，提出由Creator、Explorer、Evolver三个角色耦合世界生成与Harness进化的递归自我改进框架。Evolver依据已验证执行轨迹，把按表面类别组织的任务树重组为分层能力树；Creator对同节点异构任务做Real2Sim2Real抽象，生成简化可验证的模拟世界用于能力学习，并在原任务上测迁移；Explorer沿能力树以选择性继承演化可复用模块，形成拓扑固定的Harness树，再由能力感知路由器按公开任务信息选配模块。在28个训练benchmark上平均提升34分、18个未见benchmark上提升26分，含两个真实具身任务。
hf.reason: Agent自进化与Harness演化框架，实验扎实，直接命中Agent方向

hf.title: ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence
hf.abstract: Training a spatial VLM to answer which side an object lies on does not require it to preserve the metric displacement that determines that answer, while supervision for a distance estimate may leave categorical relations largely unconstrained. When post-training emphasizes one readout, improvements can therefore concentrate on that interface while transfer to others remains weak or even degrades; we call this observed specialization interface lock-in. ChronoReplay addresses it by replaying heterogeneous spatial supervision as chronologically ordered episodes, retaining source-native targets, and balancing supervision across families. Under the same observation access, a single ChronoReplay checkpoint improves OVO-S-Bench, OST-Bench, and UCS-Bench together, including a 13.41-point gain on OST-Bench, and achieves the highest three-benchmark mean among the supervision settings compared here. Same-data controls further separate the ingredients of this transfer: answer serialization redistributes gains across OST and UCS, family-balanced learning improves over ordinary joint SFT and natural turn weighting, and chronological replay exceeds a shifted-order control by about 2.41 OST points across two paired seeds. Adaptive frame selection then changes evidence access while keeping the trained model fixed, providing an additional inference-time gain at lower visual cost. Streaming spatial performance depends on what distinctions supervision preserves, how heterogeneous histories are organized during learning, and what causal evidence inference makes available at test time.
hf.titleZh: ChronoReplay：单一答案接口不足以支撑流式空间智能
hf.summaryZh: 空间 VLM 后训练中存在“接口锁定”现象：监督侧重某一读出接口（方位分类或距离回归）时，增益集中在对应接口，迁移到其他接口变弱甚至退化。ChronoReplay 把异构空间监督重放为按时间排序的 episode，保留源生目标并在各监督族间均衡采样。在相同观测访问下，单一 checkpoint 在 OVO-S-Bench、OST-Bench、UCS-Bench 上同步提升，OST-Bench 提升 13.41 分，三 benchmark 均值在对比的监督设置中最高；同数据对照显示答案序列化重分配增益、族均衡优于普通联合 SFT、时间重放比乱序对照高约 2.41 分。推理时固定模型做自适应帧选择，可在更低视觉成本下进一步增益。
hf.reason: 多模态空间理解的后训练数据组织与推理策略，方向贴合且实验扎实

hf.title: Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
hf.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents interact with their environments through complete assistant turns while generating each action token by token. We observe that critic values vary primarily across turns, motivating optimization anchored at turns with finer credit allocation among tokens. We propose Multiscale Policy Optimization (MPO), combining Multiscale Advantage Estimation (MAE) and turn-level importance sampling to align credit assignment and policy updates at the turn scale. Extensive experiments across search, tool-use, and automation tasks with 4B and 30B-A3B models demonstrate consistent gains over strong RL baselines.
hf.titleZh: 面向长程LLM Agent的多尺度策略优化
hf.summaryZh: 长程LLM Agent按token逐个生成动作，却以完整对话轮次与环境交互；critic value主要在轮次之间变化，使token级信用分配与轮次级决策尺度不匹配。MPO把优化锚定在轮次尺度：多尺度优势估计（MAE）跨轮次与token分配信用，轮次级重要性采样让策略更新与信用分配对齐。在搜索、工具调用与自动化任务上，4B与30B-A3B模型均稳定优于强RL基线。
hf.reason: Agentic RL 的信用分配改进，直接命中后训练与 Agent 方向

hf.title: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
hf.abstract: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a rule-consistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. Its 239 self-contained tasks in English and Chinese span 12 categories, from data stories and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers; each asks an agent, running in its native harness inside a sandbox with no image or video generation model, to deliver a finished MP4 with sound within one hour. Evaluation is hierarchical and evidence-based: program checks of the delivery spec, about 13k task-specific rubric checks traced to the requirements they enforce, and five quality dimensions anchored per task, scored by three VLM judge panels. Across nine frontier agent systems and 2,151 scored rollouts, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 rank first and second with both the judges and human annotators, and the strongest system satisfies every core requirement on 76.3% of tasks. Delivery is a second axis: counting missing videos as zero changes the ranking, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders that started too late, ran too slowly or never started, a failure of how agents plan their hour. Agents build their own rendering pipelines and inspect their own frames, yet how much they look does not predict quality. The judges' ranking of the systems closely matches blind human preferences.
hf.titleZh: VibeVideoBench：评测多模态智能体在代码驱动视频生成上的表现
hf.summaryZh: 扩散视频模型难以精确渲染公式、图表、规则一致的游戏或与画面事件同步的旁白，VibeVideoBench由此评测「写代码逐帧渲染并合成声音」的多模态智能体：239个中英双语自包含任务覆盖12类，要求在无图像/视频生成模型的沙盒中一小时内交付带声MP4；评测包含交付规格的程序检查、约1.3万条可溯源的任务专属rubric检查，以及三个VLM评审团按五个质量维度打分。在9个前沿智能体系统、2151次rollout中，GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5.5居前二，最强系统在76.3%的任务上满足全部核心要求；把缺失视频计零会改变排名，四分之三的丢失源于一小时内渲染规划失败，而智能体查看自身帧的多少并不能预测质量。
hf.reason: 智能体沙盒长时程任务与多级评测设计扎实，但产出为视频应用

hf.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
hf.abstract: Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value. Taking RAG as a reference, we dissect the net value of memory into the gains and losses over direct retrieval, termed memory benefit and memory tax. These gains and losses arise because memory process changes how the raw information is organized and accessed. We view such changes as the double-edged deviations from the raw history. They are originally designed and introduced to benefit the task, for example by reorganizing facts or distilling preferences, but some may also remove or obscure evidence, giving rise to memory tax. Since memory benefit reflects the expected gains of its design, we then focus more on the overlooked memory tax, study how it arises from the system and evaluation side, and generalize the concept to more application scenarios of memory. We hope the notion of memory tax can provide a new lens and shift more attention from standalone performance to the net value of memory, informing more reliable memory designs and evaluations. We will open-source the code and results to the community. Project Page: https://hexuan21.github.io/MemoryTax/
hf.titleZh: 记忆税：剖析 Agent 记忆的净价值
hf.summaryZh: 长程 Agent 普遍引入记忆模块，但它相对于直接从原始历史检索（naive RAG）的净价值仍缺乏系统评估。在多个 benchmark 与模型骨干上的大规模评测显示，不少专用记忆系统在诸多场景下反而不如 naive RAG，净价值为负。差值可拆解为记忆收益与记忆税：记忆过程重塑信息的组织与访问方式，既能通过重组事实、蒸馏偏好带来收益，也可能删除或遮蔽证据而形成税负。进一步从系统与评测两侧剖析记忆税的来源，并主张以净价值而非单一性能衡量记忆设计。
hf.reason: Agent 记忆的净价值剖析，提出记忆税概念，命中记忆方向

hf.title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
hf.abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.0, and 81.5% on SimplerEnv. Ablations show improved future prediction with world-model supervision and evaluate how subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT training affect action success.
hf.titleZh: PDRVLA:一种具备物理动力学表征的视觉-语言-动作模型
hf.summaryZh: VLA模型对物理动力学的理解有限，而用视频世界模型生成未来视频会给控制回路带来高延迟。为此提出轻量Physical Dynamics Module，从视觉-语言特征中提取物理token来条件化动作生成，无需在线视频生成;该模块通过直接预测未来的RGB、深度与光流特征进行学习，并以冻结的预训练视频世界模型提供辅助监督;训练仅用公开数据，经人到机器人合成、子任务标注与具身思维链(ECoT)标注扩充。四个仿真基准成功率为LIBERO 99.3%、LIBERO-Plus 89.9%、RoboTwin 2.0 93.6%、SimplerEnv 81.5%。
hf.reason: VLA与机器人操作，属画像明确划为低分的具身方向

hf.title: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
hf.abstract: Recent test-time training (TTT) frameworks have enabled open-weight large language models (LLMs) to outperform inference-only frameworks powered by frontier models on scientific discovery tasks. However, TTT introduces additional computational cost for online weight updates during the discovery process, making computational efficiency an important consideration when scaling to larger models. This motivates us to explore an efficient test-time adaptation method for scientific discovery. We introduce Test-Time Memory Evolution (TTME), a plug-and-play test-time adaptation method, as an alternative to TTT. TTME continually updates the external memory by distilling the experience to guide subsequent discovery without updating model weights. To have a clean comparison, we evaluate TTME and TTT under the same discovery framework, replacing only the test-time adaptation method. Our evaluation shows that TTME outperforms TTT on all five mathematical tasks, while reducing computational cost by 82.8-84.6% in FLOPs and 47.7-58.4% in runtime. These results establish TTME as an effective and computationally efficient alternative to TTT in the evaluated discovery settings.
hf.titleZh: 测试时记忆演化能否在科学发现任务上超越测试时训练?
hf.summaryZh: 测试时训练(TTT)需在发现过程中在线更新权重，算力开销大，难以扩展到更大模型。TTME 作为即插即用的替代方案，不更新模型权重，而是持续把经验蒸馏进外部记忆，用于指导后续的科学发现过程。在相同的发现框架下仅替换测试时自适应方法，TTME 在五个数学任务上全部优于 TTT,FLOPs 降低 82.8%至84.6%，运行时间缩短 47.7%至58.4%。这为科学发现类任务的测试时自适应提供了低成本路径，也表明外部记忆可作为权重更新的高效替代。
hf.reason: 测试时自适应加外部记忆，命中自我改进与 Agent 记忆方向

hf.title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
hf.abstract: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. Our central design aligns structured video captions with action-aware causal attention: descriptive context remains accessible across segments, while action instructions are restricted to their intended temporal windows. A vision-language Prompt Enhancer (PE) translates user requests and multimodal interaction histories into structured conditions for the next segment. A multi-stage curriculum progressively introduces causal generation, text interaction, camera control, and training on model-generated histories, followed by diffusion distillation. In human evaluation, Hy-Nomas shows superior performance over existing world models. We release model weights, code and benchmarks, together with a lightweight adaptation workflow, to support reproducible research on interactive world generation.
hf.titleZh: Hy-Nomas：迈向自由形式的交互式世界生成
hf.summaryZh: 交互式世界生成要求模型在多轮交互中遵循连续指令，同时保留相关历史与动作后果。Hy-Nomas 以 8B 扩散骨干构建视频世界模型，支持自由文本指令与连续镜头控制，并按当前输入与缓存历史生成变长片段;核心设计把结构化视频描述与动作感知的因果注意力对齐，使描述性上下文跨片段可见、动作指令只作用于其预期时间窗，再由视觉语言 Prompt Enhancer 把用户请求与多模态交互历史转为下一片段的结构化条件。训练采用多阶段课程，依次引入因果生成、文本交互、镜头控制与模型自生成历史训练，并做扩散蒸馏;人工评测中优于现有世界模型，并开源权重、代码与 benchmark。
hf.reason: 扩散视频世界模型，落在视觉生成低分方向

hf.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
hf.abstract: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ
hf.titleZh: 离散Token能否作为视觉信号的语义无损表示？
hf.summaryZh: 重新审视「量化误差导致离散视觉token语义损失、连续表示必然更优」的假设，发现量化误差并非可靠指标，离散索引的有效比特预算才是多模态理解性能的关键，而现有量化器会随码本增加而饱和。为此提出Factorized Vector Quantization：用对称并行码本量化视觉特征的互补固定维度视图，使其在更大比特预算下持续提升。基于工业级多模态数据训练，模型在九项指标平均上分别超过UniAR与Emu3-Chat 22.8%和59.2%，并首次在含细粒度OCR的任务上与Qwen3-VL等强连续表示模型竞争，为离散视觉表示支撑原生多模态基础模型提供了依据。
hf.reason: 离散视觉token与多模态理解架构，直接命中MLLM方向

hf.title: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
hf.abstract: In long-term interactions with large language model (LLM) agents, users reveal habits through their choices and actions. These habits capture implicit user information that agents must infer across conversations. However, individual observations may provide only partial evidence about a habit or when it applies. Retaining past interactions alone does not ensure that agents can infer habits and apply them appropriately. We introduce HABIT-Bench to evaluate how well agent memory systems infer habits from weak evidence and apply them to later requests. We construct synthetic user histories from task-oriented dialogue data and controlled habit graphs. The histories span hundreds of sessions across food, finance, software, and travel. Four-choice tasks assess agents' ability to infer user habits and apply them appropriately. They include temporary exceptions, changes in habits, and suggestions that users have not accepted. Sampled tasks undergo independent human review. We evaluate eight memory methods with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.3-Flash. The best-performing memory method achieves 33.61\% macro accuracy across the four domains. Performance remains limited even when annotated evidence is supplied directly. These results expose a persistent gap between access to past interactions and the ability to infer and appropriately use user habits.
hf.titleZh: HABIT-Bench：评估 Agent 记忆在纵向弱证据下的习惯归纳能力
hf.summaryZh: Agent 记忆系统能否从长期交互中的弱证据归纳用户习惯并恰当应用，现有评测缺少针对性检验。HABIT-Bench 基于任务型对话数据与受控习惯图合成用户历史，覆盖餐饮、金融、软件、旅行四个领域、数百个会话，用四选一任务考察习惯归纳与应用，并设计临时例外、习惯变化及用户未采纳的建议等情形，部分样本经人工独立复核。用 Qwen3-235B-A22B 与 GLM-5.3-Flash 评测八种记忆方法，最佳方法四领域宏平均准确率仅 33.61%，即便直接提供标注证据，性能仍受限。该工作揭示了「可访问历史」与「能归纳并恰当使用习惯」之间的持续差距，为 Agent 长期记忆与个性化提供评测基准。
hf.reason: Agent 长期记忆评测，选题与方法学均命中关注方向

hf.title: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
hf.abstract: Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures. We introduce Rollback, a policy improvement paradigm that turns world models from passive simulators into counterfactual engines: it rolls back to critical decision points, branches into alternative actions, and contrasts their outcomes to attribute success to individual decisions. This concentrates imagination where it matters most and distills counterfactual outcomes into fine-grained, action-level supervision without a separately learned value model. We build a scalable training system that unifies distributed world-model search with asynchronous real-robot execution, forming a self-reinforcing cycle: real-world experience continually sharpens the world model, and a sharper world model in turn drives further policy improvement. We term the world-model side of this cycle test-time physics grounding, a capability that hand-built physics simulators lack: while the world model serves as the training environment, real transitions from the policy it trains correct its dynamics through a lightweight LoRA pipeline. Experiments on three challenging real-world tasks show that Rollback improves success rates over the strongest baseline by an absolute 10.67%, 11.11%, and 11.85% on block extraction, ball tossing, and tabletop curling, respectively, while achieving more stable improvement throughout training. Although initialized from teleoperated demonstrations far below human level, Rollback surpasses the average success rate of human players on both ball tossing and tabletop curling within 8 hours of training.
hf.titleZh: Rollback：在世界模型中回滚经验以改进策略
hf.summaryZh: 现有以动作为条件的世界模型方法大多只把世界模型当作物理环境的前向替代，无法回溯到过去的决策点去探索反事实未来。Rollback 把世界模型从被动模拟器变成反事实引擎：回滚到关键决策点，分支出替代动作并对比其结果，从而把成功归因到具体决策，让想象集中在最关键处；同时把反事实结果蒸馏为动作级细粒度监督，无需单独学习价值模型。配套训练系统统一了分布式世界模型搜索与异步真机执行，真机转移数据经轻量 LoRA 管线持续校正世界模型动力学，形成自我强化循环。在三个真机任务上，成功率较最强基线绝对提升 10.67%、11.11%、11.85%，且训练 8 小时内即在抛球与桌面冰壶上超过人类玩家平均成功率。
hf.reason: 机器人与具身智能，属画像明确低分方向

hf.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
hf.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.
hf.titleZh: ThinkWorld：世界想象强化动力学链推理
hf.summaryZh: 面向 VLA 模型受限于动作标注机器人示教数据覆盖不足的问题，提出 ThinkWorld 框架，把每个动作思考表示为「动力学链」（CoD）——一串离散运动 token，刻画从当前世界状态到未来状态的中间动力学，并作为跨本体的统一动作表征。先用带动作标注的示教初始化 CoD，再预测每条 CoD 诱导的未来状态，对预测更贴合真实观测的 CoD 施加强化，从而让无动作标注的人类视频通过状态转移提供直接监督，人类与机器人经验共享同一推理空间。仿真与真机实验显示有效的人到机器人迁移，并对未见任务与环境具备较强泛化能力。
hf.reason: VLA 与机器人操作，属画像明确不关注的具身方向

hf.title: CodeCap-Bench: Can Code Serve as a Good Video Caption?
hf.abstract: Video captioning aims to preserve visual information through compact descriptions, predominantly using natural language. However, precisely expressing fine-grained spatial structures and temporal dynamics in natural language often leads to lengthy and potentially ambiguous descriptions. In this work, we explore Code as Video Caption, a paradigm where executable programs serve as a complementary representation of visual content through graphical primitives, layout rules, and functions of time. To examine whether code captions effectively preserve video information, we compare them with natural language captions on downstream question answering and video reconstruction tasks. Our results show that code captions achieve superior reasoning accuracy and reconstruction fidelity. Despite these advantages, realizing the potential of code captioning depends on whether current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate faithful code captions. To systematically assess this capability, we introduce CodeCap-Bench, which comprises 323 videos spanning five categories of structured 2D content, along with fine-grained annotations and a multi-level evaluation framework. Extensive experiments reveal that while leading proprietary MLLMs demonstrate promising code captioning capabilities, they still struggle to faithfully capture complex temporal dynamics, with open-source models lagging substantially behind.
hf.titleZh: CodeCap-Bench：代码能作为好的视频描述吗？
hf.summaryZh: 自然语言视频描述在表达细粒度空间结构与时序动态时往往冗长且存在歧义，该工作提出以可执行程序作为视频描述的互补表示，用图形基元、布局规则与时间函数刻画视觉内容。在下游问答与视频重建任务上对比两类描述，代码描述取得更高的推理准确率与重建保真度。为系统评估 MLLM 生成忠实代码描述的能力，构建 CodeCap-Bench，包含 5 类结构化 2D 内容的 323 个视频、细粒度标注与多级评测框架。实验显示领先的闭源 MLLM 已展现潜力，但仍难以忠实捕捉复杂时序动态，开源模型明显落后。
hf.reason: MLLM 视频理解的新表示与评测基准，方向擦边但工作扎实

hf.title: LociArt: A Unified Paradigm for Free-Style Local Video Stylization
hf.abstract: Video stylization typically transforms entire scenes, while local artistic editing requires precise region--style association, spatial control, and temporal consistency. We introduce LociArt, a unified paradigm for free-style local video stylization that explicitly specifies where to stylize and what style to apply while preserving non-target content. At its core, GRNStyle builds on Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) and introduces a polar style-aware mask that embeds style identities as equal-norm directions within selected regions. Complementary representation--geometry conditioning combines encoded mask features with raw-mask spatial support, integrating spatiotemporal context with geometric control. To provide paired supervision, we develop an automated pipeline combining global stylization, video object removal, matting, and compositing, and construct the LociArt-100K Dataset with 100K local stylization pairs. We further establish the LociArt Benchmark, comprising 80 source videos and 84 target masks covering 168 foreground/background stylization cases, with a Style Prototype Similarity (SPS) evaluation scheme for regional style quality and complementary measures of non-target preservation and temporal consistency. Experiments show that GRNStyle outperforms existing methods in regional style quality and spatial control while maintaining strong temporal consistency. Qualitative examples further illustrate joint stylization of multiple regions with the same or different learned styles, despite training only on single-region, single-style pairs. Together, these components provide a unified foundation for learning and evaluating controllable local video stylization. Project page: https://higherhu.github.io/lociart/.
hf.titleZh: LociArt：自由风格局部视频风格化的统一范式
hf.summaryZh: 面向局部视频风格化需同时满足区域—风格精确对应、空间可控与时间一致性的问题，提出统一范式 LociArt。核心组件 GRNStyle 基于生成式精炼网络（GRN），引入极坐标风格感知掩码，把风格身份编码为所选区域内等范数方向，并以「表征—几何」条件化将掩码特征与原始掩码空间支撑结合，融合时空上下文与几何控制。为获得配对监督，构建了由全局风格化、视频目标移除、抠像与合成组成的自动化流水线，产出含 10 万对样本的 LociArt-100K，并建立含 80 段源视频、84 个目标掩码、168 个前景/背景案例的 benchmark 及风格原型相似度（SPS）指标。实验显示其在区域风格质量与空间控制上优于现有方法且保持较强时间一致性，并可在仅用单区域单风格配对训练的情况下实现多区域同风格或异风格的联合风格化。
hf.reason: 视频风格化属视觉生成编辑，落在低分方向

hf.title: RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback
hf.abstract: Can AI agents autonomously train useful language models and improve them using feedback from users? We introduce RSI Arena, a two-stage study of autonomous post-training as a step toward recursive self-improvement. Ten frontier models act as training agents, each starting from NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base. During a six-day first stage, each agent has 1,000 GPU-hours and $300 in API credit on a shared 64-GPU cluster, independently selecting data, implementing training procedures, and choosing checkpoints. We evaluate their models on 20 benchmarks and through blind human evaluations. All ten agents produce working assistants, with the strongest model, trained by GPT-6 Astra, closing a median of 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap across 12 capability benchmarks. Its human-preference rating is also close to NVIDIA Instruct after statistical adjustment for answer length and formatting. In Stage 2, each agent receives the comparison records and votes involving its Stage 1 model and is given three additional days for further training. Using NVIDIA Instruct as a common reference across the two evaluation rounds, we observe an improvement from Stage 1 to Stage 2 in the style-adjusted relative rating of eight of the ten models. We show that benchmark gains were modest, with no clear link to preference gains, while some agents encouraged longer responses and one model showed increased harmful compliance on StrongREJECT. RSI Arena provides an auditable setting for studying how human feedback can guide autonomous model development. It takes a step toward recursive self-improvement with human feedback (RSIHF), in which people help define what improvement means for the AI systems they use.
hf.titleZh: RSI Arena：迈向带人类反馈的递归自我改进
hf.summaryZh: 考察AI Agent能否自主完成后训练并依据用户反馈迭代改进模型：十个前沿模型作为训练Agent，从Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base出发，在共享64卡集群上各自拥有1000 GPU小时与300美元API额度，自主选择数据、实现训练流程并挑选checkpoint。第一阶段六天内十个Agent均产出可用助手，其中GPT-6 Astra训练的模型在12项能力基准上中位填补基础模型到Instruct差距的76%，经答案长度与格式校正后人类偏好评分接近NVIDIA Instruct。第二阶段将对比记录与投票反馈回传给Agent并追加三天训练，十个模型中有八个的风格校正相对评分继续提升，但基准提升有限且与偏好提升无明确关联，部分Agent倾向更长回答，一个模型在StrongREJECT上危害合规率上升。该工作提供了可审计的自主后训练与人类反馈闭环评测环境。
hf.reason: 自主后训练与人类反馈自我改进闭环，直击后训练与Agent方向

hf.title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
hf.abstract: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect, an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. To ensure quality, a reference answer is retained only when independent VLMs agree on it, and region-ablation tests discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. We then train base VLMs on the resulting data with RLVR, obtaining Zooming without Zooming v2 (ZwZ2). Although the synthesized data are not tailored to any downstream benchmark, ZwZ2 improves fine-grained and spatial perception, with further gains on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning. These results establish EvidenceConnect as an effective framework for supervising evidence connection and suggest that strengthening this shared capability leads to more generalizable multimodal perception.
hf.titleZh: Zooming without Zooming v2：从看到细节到连接证据，迈向可泛化的多模态感知
hf.summaryZh: 空间感知与多模态长上下文理解缺少高质量、可规模化的训练数据，为此提出数据合成框架 EvidenceConnect：利用同一图像内相关区域的放大视图生成需要比较、聚合或链式推理的问题，仅保留多个独立 VLM 答案一致的参考解，并通过区域消融测试剔除选定区域被移除后答案仍然成立的样本。用这批数据以 RLVR 训练基础 VLM，得到 ZwZ2。尽管合成数据未针对任何下游 benchmark 定制，模型在细粒度与空间感知上均有提升，并进一步迁移到具身空间推理、多模态长上下文理解、多模态 agent 任务与通用视觉推理。
hf.reason: 多模态感知数据合成 + RLVR 训练，命中后训练与 MLLM 方向

hf.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
hf.abstract: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.
hf.titleZh: EmbeddingGemma 2：统一高效的多模态表征
hf.summaryZh: 在单一向量空间中统一表征文本、图像、音频、视频及其混合模态，面向跨模态检索与 RAG 场景。方法上采用简化的逐层嵌入（per-layer embeddings），并设计按模态与训练目标递进的多阶段课程，使单模态、跨模态与混合模态评测同时保持高质量。在覆盖全模态的嵌入基准上，该模型建立了新的 Pareto 前沿，性能超过专用模型以及规模大 2–12 倍的模型。工程侧支持按需加载模态编码器、可调视觉 token 预算、可截断嵌入维度与量化权重，便于在资源受限环境中部署，并公开权重与消融分析。
hf.reason: 多模态嵌入统一模型，含效率设计与充分消融，贴合多模态理解与检索

hf.title: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni: Elastic Self-Refining Unified Diffusion LLM with Cross-Paradigm On-Policy Distillation
hf.abstract: We propose Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni (NLD-Uni), a unified discrete diffusion large language model (DLLM) for visual understanding and generation tasks. Compared with prior unified diffusion models, NLD-Uni introduces two major innovations. First, we propose a unified cross-paradigm on-policy distillation (OPD) framework that successfully transfers the visual understanding ability of autoregressive VLMs and visual generation ability of continuous flow models, to a unified DLLM. Second, NLD-Uni incorporates a novel progressive self-refining diffusion process that gradually corrupts each token across multiple steps during training, as opposed to adopting the conventional masked diffusion formulation that directly corrupts a clean image token to an uninformative mask token. At inference, this design allows NLD-Uni to make intermediate commit to a token, enabling progressive self-refinement for better visual quality. Through extensive experiments, we show that NLD-Uni achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified DLLMs on diverse tasks including visual question-answering, multi-modal reasoning, object grounding, text-to-image generation, and image editing.
hf.titleZh: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni:弹性自精炼统一扩散 LLM 与跨范式同策略蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: 将自回归视觉语言模型的理解能力与连续流模型的生成能力，通过跨范式同策略蒸馏(OPD)迁移进同一个离散扩散语言模型，以缓解统一扩散模型中理解与生成能力彼此割裂的问题。训练阶段采用渐进式自精炼扩散:每个 token 在多个步骤中被逐步加噪，而非传统掩码扩散一步将干净图像 token 替换为无信息 mask token;因此推理时可对 token 做中间提交并逐步精修。在视觉问答、多模态推理、目标定位、文生图与图像编辑等任务上，该模型在统一 DLLM 中取得 state-of-the-art。
hf.reason: 跨范式同策略蒸馏有意思，但扩散语言模型与视觉生成属低分方向

hf.title: On the SPOT: Enhancing Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models via Commit-Order Prediction
hf.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise parallel text generation, but in practice face an unresolved speed-quality trade-off. Exact decoding fills in only one masked position per model pass, while faster multi-token decoding schemes are lossy. Speculative decoding is the standard lossless acceleration for autoregressive models. However, it does not transfer directly to DLMs, which must choose both what to generate and where. We show that this order is the missing piece: the model's own predictions from the previous pass already give the right token at over 90% of positions, but not which position comes next. We introduce Speculating Positions Order Trajectory (SPOT), a 0.62M-parameter model that reads only the target's output distributions, predicts this order and proposes a tree of candidate continuations, which the target verifies in a single pass by state equality. Coupled-noise match, which shares Gumbel noise between drafter and target, keeps this verification exact at any temperature. This approach also inspired us to introduce SPOT-Sets for dynamic threshold decoding, where a pass commits several positions: SPOT-Sets drafts whole commit sets together with their tokens. Our comprehensive experiments show that SPOT cuts target passes by up to 6.8times and reaches up to 3.4times the throughput of standard decoding on SDAR-8B, matching or beating the calibrated and training-free drafting baselines in every task and budget at T=0 and T=1. In addition, we show that SPOT's learned drafter transfers across models, demonstrating successful transfer across six different DLMs; with a light calibration, the SPOT-Sets drafter transfers as well. On top of dynamic threshold decoding, SPOT-Sets improves the throughput of SDAR-8B by 59% on average over the threshold decoder alone. Project page: https://eliezer318.github.io/SPOT-dLLM/
hf.titleZh: On the SPOT:通过提交顺序预测增强扩散语言模型的投机解码
hf.summaryZh: 扩散语言模型可并行生成文本，但速度与质量难以兼顾:精确解码每次前向只填入一个掩码位置，多 token 解码则有损。投机解码在自回归模型上无损加速，却难以直接迁移到扩散语言模型，因为后者还需决定「在哪个位置」生成。SPOT 用一个仅 0.62M 参数的小模型，只读取目标模型的输出分布来预测提交顺序，并据此提出候选续写树，由目标模型单次前向以状态相等校验;耦合噪声匹配在 drafter 与 target 间共享 Gumbel 噪声，使校验在任意温度下保持精确;SPOT-Sets 进一步为动态阈值解码整组提交位置与对应 token。在 SDAR-8B 上，target 前向次数最多减少 6.8 倍，吞吐达标准解码的 3.4 倍，并可跨六种扩散语言模型迁移，SPOT-Sets 在阈值解码器之上平均再提吞吐 59%。
hf.reason: 投机解码加速扩散语言模型，属效率方向但踩扩散低分项

hf.title: What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents
hf.abstract: Generative models increasingly expose a reasoning effort setting that lets users scale inference-time compute, trading higher cost for potentially improved performance. Users must choose an effort level before knowing whether extra reasoning will help, and even a successful run does not reveal whether the effort purchased was necessary. Reasoning effort is therefore a credence good: buyers observe the outcome but cannot assess the marginal value of the computation they paid for. In this work, we measure the counterfactual effect of effort levels on both proprietary and open-weight models on four benchmarks, spanning single-call reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks. Effort, it turns out, does not consistently preserve tasks that lower effort solves, can overspend, and can change trajectory behavior. First, we find that although higher effort can raise accuracy in aggregate, it frequently fails on tasks that lower effort solved. Second, on the subset of easy tasks that every effort level solves, higher effort is generally more costly, with the highest effort level costing up to 42x as much as the lowest. Lastly, effort changes not only how many tokens are used, but also how agents solve tasks: at higher effort, agents verify their own work more heavily and more often search for solutions than work through problems directly, both of which lengthen trajectories without necessarily altering the outcome. These findings show that naively choosing the highest level is not only cost-inefficient but also offers no guarantee of the best instance-level performance. A simple alternative, starting at the lowest effort and escalating only after a verified failure, matches or improves on fixed top effort across all models and benchmarks at lower cost for most proprietary models.
hf.titleZh: 我该选择什么推理努力等级？论 LLM Agent 中推理努力的经济学
hf.summaryZh: 推理努力档位让用户在不知道是否有效前先付费，且成功结果也无法揭示这部分算力是否必要，因而构成一种信任品(credence good)。该工作在专有与开放权重模型、四个基准(单次推理与长程 Agent 任务)上测量努力等级的反事实效应:更高努力虽能提升总体准确率，却常在同一批低努力即可解决的任务上失败;对全部档位都能解决的简单任务，最高档成本可达最低档的 42 倍;更高努力还会改变解题轨迹，更多自检与更多搜索而非直接推导，拉长轨迹却不改变结果。据此提出的替代策略——从最低档起步、仅在验证失败后升级——在所有模型与基准上以更低成本匹配或超过固定最高档。
hf.reason: 推理努力与 test-time scaling 的成本效益分析，直击 Agent 推理部署

hf.title: MatAnyone-E: Sparse Memory Propagation for Efficient High-Resolution Video Matting
hf.abstract: High-resolution video matting requires preserving fine details, such as hair strands and soft transparency, while maintaining consistency across frames. Memory-based methods achieve strong matting quality by matching current-frame features with information stored from earlier frames, but this process becomes increasingly costly as resolution grows. We present MatAnyone-E, an efficient extension of MatAnyone 2 that focuses computation where it is most needed. Our approach first performs low-resolution propagation to identify uncertain regions that require closer inspection and the memory candidates most relevant to them. It then performs high-resolution matching only for these regions using the selected memory, while reusing low-resolution matching results elsewhere. This strategy reduces both the number of locations requiring detailed matching and the amount of memory searched, while preserving the information needed to produce a complete matte. We further reduce the cost of generating high-resolution mattes with a lightweight decoder designed around measured runtime bottlenecks and trained to reproduce the original decoder's representations. Experiments show that MatAnyone-E maintains matting quality comparable to MatAnyone 2 while achieving an estimated 7.4x inference speedup and reducing peak GPU memory usage to 7.6% of the usage of MatAnyone 2 at 4K. With compilation-enabled inference on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, it reaches 73.07 FPS at 1080p and 28.62 FPS at 4K.
hf.titleZh: MatAnyone-E：面向高效高分辨率视频抠像的稀疏记忆传播
hf.summaryZh: 高分辨率视频抠像既要保留发丝等细节，又要维持帧间一致；基于记忆的方法通过把当前帧特征与历史帧信息匹配来达到高质量，但开销会随分辨率增长迅速上升。MatAnyone-E 先做低分辨率传播，定位需要细查的不确定区域及其最相关的记忆候选，仅在这些区域用所选记忆做高分辨率匹配，其余位置复用低分辨率结果，从而同时减少需精细匹配的位置数与记忆搜索量。它还用按实测运行时瓶颈设计的轻量解码器复现原解码器表征，以降低高分辨率抠像图的生成成本。在4K下峰值显存降至 MatAnyone 2 的7.6%，估计推理加速7.4倍，单张 NVIDIA H200 上1080p达73.07 FPS、4K达28.62 FPS，画质与原模型相当。
hf.reason: 视频抠像的稀疏匹配加速，与LLM关注方向无交集

hf.title: h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving
hf.abstract: While progress in informal mathematics has come largely from scaling the chain-of-thought and agentic reasoning of frontier language models, formal theorem proving has increasingly relied on human-designed workflows around these models, such as planning, decomposition, and orchestrating specialized provers. This raises a bitter-lesson question: can a simple agentic loop that scales test-time compute match these workflows? The answer matters as formal verification must scale to keep up with frontier models producing research mathematics, yet new workflows rarely settle it, as their gains are often confounded with stronger models or more compute. We study this question with h1, a simple harness that gives a model an efficient interface to Lean 4 and keeps it working through verifier feedback and self-reflection, without imposing a decomposition or search structure. h1 reaches state-of-the-art results on PutnamBench, FATE-X, and FormalConjectures100-Solved, settles eight open problems in FormalConjectures, and, at matched models, matches or outperforms specialized workflows such as Goedel-Architect and AlphaProof Nexus, surprisingly showing that a single attempt (pass@1) can often scale to solve open problems. Through ablations and matched-model comparisons with Claude Code and AxProverBase, we find that simplicity alone is not enough: an efficient Lean interface largely determines cost and solve rate. We thus recommend that future work evaluate frontier models with efficient execution feedback before prescribing workflows, at the risk of bitter lessons.
hf.titleZh: h1：自动定理证明中的一剂「苦涩教训」
hf.summaryZh: 形式定理证明愈发依赖人类设计的规划、分解与专用证明器编排流程，核心追问是：只靠简单智能体循环扩展测试时计算能否追平这些流程。h1 为此构建了一个简易 harness，为模型提供高效的 Lean 4 接口，仅通过验证器反馈与自我反思持续迭代，不施加分解或搜索结构；它在 PutnamBench、FATE-X、FormalConjectures100-Solved 上取得 SOTA，解决八道开放问题，同模型下追平或超过 Goedel-Architect、AlphaProof Nexus 等工作流。消融与同模型对比显示，高效的 Lean 接口而非流程结构主要决定成本与求解率。
hf.reason: 形式证明的极简 agentic harness，命中 Agent 与测试时扩展方向

hf.title: Cross-modal Steering Vectors Exist Across Both Image and Text Generation
hf.abstract: Are concepts and mechanisms unified across modalities in current AI models, or instead implemented separately for each one? We operationalize this broad question of modality unification by studying cross-modal steering: 1) finding vectors that successfully steer generation on tokens of one modality, which then 2) transfer zero-shot to steer generation when added to tokens of another modality. Our study goes beyond simple correlational alignment (e.g. representational similarity) because steering is fundamentally causal. We study cross-modal steering in several unified multimodal models (UMMs), since they possess shared parameters for language and image generation, focusing on these two modalities. Across diverse steered concepts such as emotion and object size, we show that steering vectors transfer zero-shot in both directions (text-to-image & image-to-text). Even for concepts that are highly unique to one modality (e.g. formal vs. colloquial language), steering vectors often induce a consistent, interpretable effect in the other modality, such as formal clothing and design. This transfer has a geometric signature too: despite a clear modality gap separating text and image representations, steering vectors with strong cross-modal transferability tend to point in similar directions for the same concept. Our findings shed light on how vision and language interact inside unified multimodal models and point towards more general, modality-agnostic approaches for controlling their behavior.
hf.titleZh: 跨模态引导向量在图像与文本生成中均存在
hf.summaryZh: 针对统一多模态模型中视觉与语言的概念机制是否共享这一问题，以因果性的引导（steering）而非表征相似度为切入点：在多个统一多模态模型的文本 token 与图像 token 上分别提取引导向量，检验其能否零样本迁移，去引导另一模态的生成。跨情绪、物体大小等概念，双向迁移（文→图、图→文）均成立；即便高度模态特有的概念（如正式 vs 口语化语言）也常在另一模态引发一致、可解释的效果，如正式服装与设计风格。几何上，尽管文本与图像表征间存在明显模态间隔，迁移性强的引导向量在同一概念下方向相近。该结果揭示统一多模态模型内部视觉与语言的交互方式，并指向模态无关的行为控制方法。
hf.reason: 统一多模态模型的表征与激活引导，贴近MLLM架构与可控性方向

hf.title: Channel Selection for Mixture-of-Experts Decoding Needs No Calibration Data
hf.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are bottlenecked by loading routed-expert weights from memory during interactive decoding at small batch sizes. Because most intermediate channels in a routed expert contribute little to any single token, channel selectors predict which channels matter and read only their weights, typically keeping channels above a threshold calibrated on offline data. We show that channel selection needs no calibration data. First, a calibrated threshold does not fix how much a selector reads, because the number of channels passing it varies across inputs; Prox with thresholds calibrated for an 18% read budget actually reads only 12.9% on average across our benchmarks. Second, top-k keeps each token's k highest-scoring channels and needs no calibration data. At the calibrated budget, a selector's top-k version matches or beats its threshold version on the same score in 40 of 43 comparisons at 13% and 18% budgets, including all 23 on generation tasks. The top-k versions also avoid the repetition-loop collapse that calibrated thresholds cause on Gemma 4. Calibrating a threshold thus provides neither of the two things selectors use it for: a known read budget and a consistent accuracy gain at that budget. We furthermore introduce a reader built entirely from the model's weights, which screens channels with a ternary sketch and recovers the skipped ones with a low-rank map. Across three post-trained MoE models, our reader retains 98.1% of full-model accuracy at 17.8% of routed-expert reads, with Triton kernels running MoE blocks 1.60 to 1.90x faster than optimized vLLM at batch one and up to 2.69x at larger batches on the same three models.
hf.titleZh: MoE解码的通道选择无需校准数据
hf.summaryZh: MoE解码在小批量下受限于从内存加载路由专家权重，通道选择器预测每个token需要哪些中间通道并只读取其权重。该工作指出通道选择无需校准数据：校准阈值无法固定读取预算，按18%预算校准的Prox实际平均只读12.9%；而top-k直接保留每个token得分最高的k个通道，在13%与18%预算下的43项比较中有40项匹配或超过阈值版本，生成任务23项全部不劣，并避免Gemma 4上校准阈值引发的重复循环崩溃。进一步提出完全由模型权重构建的读取器，用三值sketch筛选通道并以低秩映射恢复被跳过通道；在三个后训练MoE模型上以17.8%的路由专家读取保留98.1%全模型准确率，Triton内核在batch为1时比优化vLLM快1.60至1.90倍，更大batch最高2.69倍。
hf.reason: MoE推理通道选择与Triton加速，命中高效推理方向

hf.title: Omni-InteractScope: Benchmarking Proactive and Agentic Interaction in Continuous Omnimodal Streams
hf.abstract: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) are increasingly expected to assist users while observing continuous audiovisual streams. However, existing evaluations provide limited insight into how reliably these models connect stream evidence and user needs to timely, sustained interventions. We introduce Omni-InteractScope, a benchmark of 1,479 human-annotated, cross-reviewed interactions with 1,790 temporal targets across eight task groups. It links input modalities, event triggers, intervention types, and user needs, covering event-timed tool invocation and query-free assistance alongside notifications, warnings, state tracking, and continuous responses. Our experimental results on the proposed benchmark reveal three critical limitations of current Omni-LLMs: (1) Timely tool invocation remains unreliable: all 12 evaluated models produce an on-time first response for at most 40\% of tool-invocation targets, and joint timing-and-tool accuracy reaches at most 32.0\%. (2) Query-free reminders remain poorly covered: all evaluated models achieve lower timely reference-target recall on query-free reminders than on explicit questions, measured on their respective target sets. Reminder recall never exceeds 23.0\%. (3) End-to-end guidance coverage remains limited: nine models cover none of the 26 guidance sequences in full, and the remaining three cover only one to three sequences each. Targeted controls further show that tool-invocation scores alone do not establish event grounding and that reminder coverage depends on response history and frequency. These findings motivate developing and evaluating streaming assistants for timely action, initiative under general user needs, and coverage of entire response sequences.
hf.titleZh: Omni-InteractScope：在连续全模态流中评测主动式与Agentic交互
hf.summaryZh: 全模态大模型需要在连续音视频流中主动干预，但缺少对「流证据—用户需求—及时行动」这条链条的可靠评测。Omni-InteractScope构建了1,479条经人工标注与交叉复核的交互、1,790个时间目标，分为八类任务组，把输入模态、事件触发、干预类型与用户需求关联起来，覆盖事件定时的工具调用、无查询主动提醒、状态跟踪与连续响应。12个被测模型对工具调用目标的准时首响应率最高仅40%，时序与工具联合准确率最高32.0%;无查询提醒的及时召回不超过23.0%;26条引导序列中九个模型无一完整覆盖。结果表明，流式助手的及时行动、主动性与序列级覆盖仍是明显短板。
hf.reason: 全模态流式Agent评测基准，覆盖工具调用与主动干预，方向对口

hf.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
hf.abstract: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.
hf.titleZh: LLM 能否通过自由探索发现隐藏的物理定律？
hf.summaryZh: 科学发现常始于一次意外观察，若世界物理规律被改写，LLM 能否自主注意到「重物下落更慢」这类异常并在无任务提示下通过实验找出定律？为此构建 LongChang 自动化框架，生成物理规律被改写的模拟世界，LLM 作为探索者自行操纵物体、设计工具提出假设，另有独立 LLM agent 生成与审查场景、审核工具设计、依据改写后的物理定律与探索记录评估报告正确性，记录还驱动场景演化，全流程无需人工介入。12 个模型中仅 GPT-6-Astra 发现率达 16.7%，其余 11 个均为 0%，探索记录显示大量异常未被追查、定律仅被部分识别。该工作为 LLM 自主科学发现与 Agent 环境合成提供了可自动评测的探针。
hf.reason: LLM 自主科学发现与 Agent 环境合成，评测方法学扎实

hf.title: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
hf.abstract: Long-horizon agents continuously encounter reusable procedural knowledge, yet existing systems typically rely either on model adaptation or external memory, trading persistent learning for rapid reuse. This limitation is especially important for Web agents that repeatedly execute related multi-step workflows. We propose HaMo, a Harness-Model collaborative framework that combines fast non-parametric experience accumulation with slow parametric adaptation. HaMo distills trajectories into strategy-level experience cards for immediate retrieval, while an experience-conditioned continual learning objective trains the model to interpret, ground, and execute retrieved strategies across changing contexts. A retrieval-coverage-based selection mechanism further identifies compact and complementary trajectories for parameter updates. Experiments show that HaMo outperforms harness-only and model-only adaptation under within-domain and cross-domain shifts, improving both retention and adaptation. These results highlight the importance of jointly preserving procedural experience and internalizing the competence to transfer and execute it across tasks.
hf.titleZh: Harness-Model 协同的长程持续学习
hf.summaryZh: 面向反复执行相关多步工作流的 Web agent，现有系统只在模型参数适配与外部记忆之间二选一，难以兼顾持久学习与快速复用。HaMo 将快慢两条路径结合:把轨迹蒸馏为策略级经验卡供即时检索，并用经验条件化的持续学习目标训练模型在多变的上下文中理解、落地与执行检索到的策略;同时以基于检索覆盖度的选择机制挑出紧凑互补的轨迹用于参数更新。在域内与跨域迁移实验中，HaMo 在保持性与适应性上均优于纯 harness 与纯模型适配方案。
hf.reason: Harness 与模型协同的持续学习，直接命中 Agent 与后训练方向

hf.title: The Lexical Imprint of Pre-training Data
hf.abstract: How much of zero-shot benchmark accuracy is captured by word-level alignment between a pre-training corpus and the benchmark target? We study this question through word-level unigram cross-entropy (UCE), a tokenizer-agnostic, model-free measure of lexical alignment between a reference corpus and a target benchmark. Likelihood training shapes the model's predictive distribution from the pre-training corpus, and zero-shot scores under likelihood-based evaluation depend in part on the lexical alignment between that corpus and the benchmark target. Cleanly tracing how the lexical imprint of pre-training data scales with corpus--benchmark alignment requires controlled from-scratch pre-training that varies corpus identity while holding the training recipe fixed. Across this controlled sweep, spanning 10 zero-shot benchmarks, 4 pre-training corpora, and 3 model scales, we find that corpus--benchmark lexical alignment, UCE, consistently tracks zero-shot accuracy on every benchmark, with corpora more aligned with the benchmark (lower UCE) achieving higher accuracy. The same signal extends from measurement to control at finer scopes. At the document level, strengthening the imprint by selecting training documents to maximize lexical alignment with the benchmark produces the accuracy gains predicted by the mechanism. At the prompt level, matching the imprint per prompt by routing each prompt to the drafter whose domain corpus is most lexically aligned with it produces measurable throughput gains over a generalist-drafter baseline. Taken together, pre-training corpora leave a measurable lexical imprint on base-model zero-shot behavior, and UCE provides a model-free probe of lexical alignment between reference and target data.
hf.titleZh: 预训练数据的词法印记
hf.summaryZh: 零样本benchmark准确率有多少可以由预训练语料与目标benchmark之间的词级对齐来解释，这直接关系到数据选择与评测可靠性。研究采用词级unigram交叉熵（UCE）作为工具；它是一种与tokenizer无关、无需模型的词汇对齐度量，并借助固定训练配方、仅更换语料的从头预训练进行受控扫描，覆盖10个零样本benchmark、4个预训练语料与3个模型规模。结果显示，UCE在每个benchmark上都稳定地跟随零样本准确率：语料与benchmark越对齐（UCE越低），准确率越高。这一信号还可用于控制：在文档级，按词法对齐筛选训练文档，能够带来该机制所预测的精度提升；在提示级，把每个提示路由到领域语料与它最对齐的drafter，相比通用drafter可获得可测的吞吐提升。
hf.reason: 预训练数据与评测对齐的受控研究，方法简洁可信，属预训练与评测交叉方向

hf.title: RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions
hf.abstract: Learning controllable world dynamics from heterogeneous interaction videos is challenging because robot embodiments use incompatible action spaces, while human videos lack native control labels. We present RynnWorld-Latent, a cross-embodiment video world model that uses the 3D-grounded latent actions introduced by RynnLAM as a shared conditioning interface. This representation enables joint pretraining on human interaction videos, robot demonstrations, and simulation rollouts without requiring a common native action space. Built on a pretrained video transformer, RynnWorld-Latent combines global action tokens with an identity-initialized local pathway that aligns actions with future video latents. We pretrain on 23 datasets comprising approximately 553.5M frames and adapt the model to target robots through post-training. The framework supports two data-generation routes: digital teleoperation uses target robot commands to generate action-video demonstrations, while latent-action synthesis transfers source motion to an edited initial frame and pairs the resulting rollout with retargeted pseudo robot actions. Experiments show improved video prediction metrics on public benchmarks and two real-robot platforms, alongside qualitative action following when different action sequences share the same initial observation. Synthetic mid-training improves policy success rates on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and both generation routes improve real-world policy success rates over real-demonstration-only training in the evaluated settings. These results support universal latent actions as a scalable interface for learning controllable visual dynamics across heterogeneous embodiments.
hf.titleZh: RynnWorld-Latent：以通用潜动作为条件的跨具身世界模型
hf.summaryZh: 不同机器人具身的动作空间互不兼容，人类视频又缺少原生控制标签，因此难以从异构交互视频中学习可控的世界动态。RynnWorld-Latent 以 RynnLAM 提出的三维接地潜动作作为共享条件接口，在预训练视频 Transformer 上把全局动作 token 与身份初始化的局部分支结合，将动作对齐到未来视频潜表示，从而无需统一原生动作空间即可联合预训练人类交互视频、机器人演示与仿真 rollout（23 个数据集、约 5.535 亿帧），再经后训练适配目标机器人。框架给出数字遥操作与潜动作合成两条数据生成路线，在公开基准和两个真实机器人平台上改善视频预测指标，合成 mid-training 提升 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-Plus 的策略成功率，两条路线在实测设置下也优于仅用真实演示训练。
hf.reason: 具身世界模型与机器人策略，整体落在画像低分方向

hf.title: Benchmarking Obstacle-Conditioned Safety in Household Robot Navigation
hf.abstract: Safe household navigation requires robots to regulate clearance and speed according to what an obstacle is and how close it is, without unnecessary conservatism. Yet existing evaluations do not test whether semantic safety distinctions are reflected in continuous motion. To that end, we introduce OSMA-Bench, an Obstacle-Conditioned Safe Motion Adaptation Benchmark built on spatially matched scenario sets that differ only in obstacle type. We also propose the Semantic Sensitivity Index (SSI), which measures whether clearance and distance-dependent speed and smoothness follow the caution ordering of obstacles. Evaluating VLM-based and vision-language-action (VLA) policies on the benchmark, we find that neither consistently adapts its motion to obstacle safety, even with explicit safety prompts. Our analysis shows that the policies can correctly distinguish obstacles by safety relevance but fail to reflect this distinction in the motion parameters or actions they produce. For VLM-based policies, which recognize the obstacle and then generate a navigation program, adding an explicit parameter-inference step between these two stages improves adaptation. These findings expose a gap in semantic-to-motion grounding, highlighting the need to translate semantic caution into appropriately safe motion.
hf.titleZh: 家庭机器人导航中障碍物条件安全性的基准评测
hf.summaryZh: 现有评测无法检验语义层面的安全区分是否体现在连续运动上。作者构建了OSMA-Bench：用仅在障碍物类型上不同的空间匹配场景集，评测策略是否按障碍物的危险程度调整间距与速度；并提出语义敏感度指数（SSI），度量间距及随距离变化的速度与平滑度是否符合障碍物的谨慎排序。评测发现，基于VLM与VLA的策略即使加显式安全提示也无法稳定地按障碍物安全等级调整运动，它们能识别障碍物的安全相关性，却不把它转化为运动参数；在识别与生成导航程序之间插入显式参数推断步骤可改善适配。
hf.reason: 机器人导航安全评测，属具身智能低分方向

arxiv.title: HEARSAYBENCH: Can AI Navigate from Abstract Human Rights to Lived Lives?
arxiv.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) reach users worldwide, personal counseling has emerged as one of their most consequential applications, sometimes in life-critical situations. Yet broader access does not mean equal support. The text these models learn from disproportionately reflects people with the freedom to act, embedding an implicit assumption that users can leave, report, seek help, or appeal. Existing benchmarks largely inherit this assumption, overlooking users whose agency is constrained by structural conditions such as war, statelessness, and displacement. Meanwhile, models are increasingly shaped by normative frameworks such as Constitutional AI, often grounded in ideals like human rights, even as many users live where those rights offer little protection or recourse. We introduce HEARSAYBENCH, a human-authored dataset of 400 test cases with in-region human verification grounded in scenarios where structural barriers stand between a person and the exercise of their rights. Built from United Nations and other human rights reports, the scenarios span over 80 regions and cover social, environmental, and personal constraints. Drawing on Nobel laureate Amartya Sen's Capabilities Approach, HEARSAYBENCH tests whether models can distinguish what a person is formally entitled to do from what they are actually able to do. Across 14 proprietary and open-weight models, every model infers a user's situation more accurately than it advises on it. Stronger models narrow this gap, but their recommendations remain unsafe to follow. Models may understand lives shaped by constraint, yet that knowledge remains hearsay if it cannot translate into advice people can act on. Those people are not alignment's long tail; they are among the users for whom good guidance matters most. HEARSAYBENCH makes this failure measurable, a step toward systems that serve the world as it is rather than as assumed.
arxiv.titleZh: HEARSAYBENCH：AI 能否从抽象人权走向真实生活？
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 LLM 心理与生活咨询类评测隐含「用户有行动自由」的假设，忽略了战争、无国籍、流离失所等结构性约束下的用户。HEARSAYBENCH 基于联合国等人权报告构建 400 条人工撰写、区域内人工验证的测试用例，覆盖 80 余个地区，并借用 Amartya Sen 的能力 approach 区分「形式上应享」与「实际可行」。在 14 个闭源与开源模型上，所有模型推断处境的准确率都高于给出建议的准确率，强模型差距更小但建议仍不安全可循。该工作把「理解」与「可执行建议」之间的落差变成可测量指标，适用于对齐与安全评测。
arxiv.reason: LLM 对齐与评测新基准，选题有价值但属社会应用向

arxiv.title: Tracing the Influence of Retrieved Literature on Scientific Ideation in LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate research ideas from scientific literature. Existing systems combine literature retrieval with search, generation, and refinement, making it difficult to determine how the retrieval strategy itself shapes the ideas generated. We isolate this contribution by comparing five retrieval strategies and a No Literature baseline under a shared generation protocol, using 45,000 ideas across 15 machine learning topics and ten open-weight models. Relative to no literature basline, all five retrieval strategies reduce diversity among ideas generated from the same set of papers by $5.6\%$--$17.9\%$, while most increase diversity by $10.2\%$--$18.1\%$ when ideas from different sets are pooled. Effects on idea quality and novelty are modest on average but vary across topics. We further apply a JSD-based attribution method to trace the influence of individual input papers on each idea's motivation, core idea, approach, and validation. In $79.3\%$ of ideas, only one or two distinct papers receive the highest attribution scores across these four parts. These leading sources often recur across ideas generated from the same set of papers, and groups with more varied source attribution contain more diverse ideas ($r=0.70$). These findings motivate various sets of literature and the use of attribution to guide the choice of sources for subsequent ideas.
arxiv.titleZh: 追踪检索文献对LLM科研想法生成的影响
arxiv.summaryZh: 检索增强的科研想法生成系统通常把检索、搜索、生成与精炼串联起来，因此难以判断检索策略本身如何塑造想法。该工作固定生成协议，比较五种检索策略与无文献基线，覆盖15个机器学习主题、10个开源权重模型、共45,000个想法，并用基于JSD的归因方法追踪单篇输入论文对想法动机、核心思路、方法与验证四部分的影响。结果显示：相比无文献基线，五种检索策略使同一批论文生成的想法多样性下降5.6%–17.9%，而混合不同论文集合时多数策略的多样性提升10.2%–18.1%；对想法质量与新颖性的平均影响有限且因主题而异；79.3%的想法中仅一到两篇论文在四部分获得最高归因，来源归因更多样的组想法也更多样（r=0.70）。这说明应使用多样化的文献集合，并以归因指导后续想法生成的来源选择。
arxiv.reason: AI for Research 中检索影响归因分析，实验规模扎实但偏测量

arxiv.title: When Does Closed-Loop Curriculum Adaptation Help GRPO? An Analysis on Countdown
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning has become an effective post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, but it remains sample-inefficient when the training distribution is mismatched to the model's current capability. In group-relative objectives such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), problems that are too hard often produce uniformly failed rollouts, while problems that are too easy provide little useful advantage signal. In this work, we introduce CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN, a lightweight adaptive curriculum method for efficient reinforcement fine-tuning on ordered reasoning tasks. Instead of following a fixed easy-to-hard schedule, CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN preserves the structure of an Easy-to-Hard Gaussian sampler while dynamically adjusting its pace and spread using periodic probe estimates of per-difficulty accuracy. The controller accelerates training when the model is ahead of a reference curriculum, slows down when the model falls behind, and broadens sampling when earlier difficulties regress. This feedback mechanism keeps training focused on tasks that are challenging but still learnable, without changing the reward function, model architecture, or underlying GRPO optimizer. Experiments on symbolic arithmetic reasoning task show that CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN improves exact-match accuracy over vanilla GRPO and fixed open-loop curricula, with the strongest gains in intermediate-difficulty regimes where group-relative learning signals are most informative. Codes are available at https://github.com/yuvrajpant56/Closed_Loop_Curriculum.
arxiv.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, Accepted at IEEE ICTAI 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 闭环课程自适应何时能帮助GRPO?基于Countdown的分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对GRPO在训练分布与模型能力不匹配时样本效率低的问题:过难题目往往导致rollout全部失败，过易题目又几乎没有优势信号;该工作提出轻量自适应课程方法CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN，保留Easy-to-Hard高斯采样器的结构，用周期性测评估计各难度准确率来动态调整推进节奏与采样宽度，模型领先参考课程时加速、落后时减速、先前难度出现回退时扩大采样范围，且不改动奖励函数、模型架构与GRPO优化器。在符号算术推理(Countdown)任务上，其精确匹配准确率优于vanilla GRPO与固定开环课程，中间难度区间增益最明显。该方法为RLVR中按难度调度训练数据提供了可复用参考。

arxiv.title: BASILISC: Bayesian Alignment of Siamese-Integrated Latents for Inferring Single-cell Correspondence
arxiv.abstract: Single-cell assays study the genome one cell at a time. Unimodal assays measure one molecular layer, the newer multimodal assays measure several. Most data are single-modality, so integrating them relies on models trained on multimodal assays, where the cell correspondence across modalities is known. These models return a matching, but rarely a confidence measure. We present BASILISC (Bayesian Alignment of Siamese-Integrated Latents for Inferring Single-cell Correspondence), a framework for matching single-cell representations with uncertainty on the correspondence itself. A BASILISC model is a probabilistic siamese network over the two modalities with a predictive distribution over the correspondence for a cross-modal pair of cells. We instantiate it at two levels: at the cell-type level the question is whether two cells share a cell type, at the cell level which cell is the partner in the other modality. To our knowledge, this is the first uncertainty score on a learned cross-modal correspondence evaluated against a known ground-truth pairing. BASILISC learns a similarity across modalities that reflects cell lineage: an unseen cell type is matched to its lineage relative, matching still works on such held-out types (balanced accuracy 0.86 on unseen against 0.93 on seen types), and the predictive uncertainty rises on these out-of-distribution cells. The uncertainty score also selects high-quality matches for downstream analysis: discarding the least certain fifth of the pairs raises accuracy from 0.93 to 0.98. At the cell level, a deep ensemble of the deterministic matcher reaches 0.062 matching accuracy on the benchmark test set, above the competition winner; on the Bayesian matcher's assignment, the posterior flags the wrong matches that cross a cell-type boundary better than a deterministic read of the same scores (AUROC 0.68 against 0.64).

arxiv.titleZh: BASILISC：用于推断单细胞对应关系的孪生集成潜变量贝叶斯对齐
arxiv.summaryZh: 单细胞多模态数据整合依赖在多模态测定上训练的匹配模型，但这些模型只输出匹配结果，缺少对匹配本身的置信度。BASILISC把跨模态匹配建模为概率孪生网络，对一对跨模态细胞给出对应关系的预测分布，并在细胞类型级与细胞级两个粒度实例化。细胞类型级上对未见类型仍保持0.86平衡准确率（已见类型0.93），分布外细胞的不确定性上升；丢弃最不确定的五分之一配对可将准确率从0.93提升到0.98。细胞级上深度集成达到0.062匹配准确率，超过竞赛冠军，贝叶斯后验识别跨类型错误匹配的AUROC为0.68，高于确定性读法的0.64。
