arxiv.title: Reinforcement Learning for the Game of Balatro: A Fast Simulator and Two-Policy Training Approach
arxiv.abstract: Balatro, a 2024 roguelike deckbuilder, presents three difficulties that have historically derailed reinforcement learning methods: a 3,000-action state-dependent action space, horizons of several hundred decisions with sparse rewards, and pervasive stochasticity in both card draws and shop generation. Published RL results on the game remain scarce. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline comprising (i) a high-throughput Rust simulator that is automatically state-diffed against the live game client via BalatroBot, (ii) a condensed observation-action interface with dynamic per-step masking of legal moves, and (iii) a multi-agent PPO architecture that decomposes play into a tactical blind policy and a strategic shop policy that share the full game state but act in disjoint phases. Long-horizon credit assignment is partially addressed by per-agent reward routing with explicit cross-agent credit. On the main joint run, training metrics show a sharp phase transition in which the first-blind clear rate converges above 99% and mean episode return increases by roughly an order of magnitude, plateauing at a mean maximum ante of 3 out of 8; single-agent baselines under identical rewards oscillated between greedy and hoarding failure modes and did not stably clear the first blind. These results establish the two-policy decomposition as a strong reactive baseline for Balatro and localise the remaining gap to long-horizon strategic planning rather than tactical blind play.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at EXAG 2026 (AIIDE Workshop on Experimental AI in Games)
arxiv.titleZh: 《Balatro》游戏的强化学习：一个快速模拟器与双策略训练方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对《Balatro》中三千动作、数百步决策以及卡牌与商店双重随机性带来的强化学习难题，构建了端到端流水线：用 Rust 实现的高吞吐模拟器，并通过 BalatroBot 与真实游戏客户端做自动状态差分校验；采用精简的观测-动作接口，按时间步动态屏蔽非法动作；同时把玩法拆成战术性盲注策略与策略性商店策略两个智能体，共享完整游戏状态，但分阶段各自行动，由 PPO 训练，并以按智能体分配奖励、显式跨智能体信用的方式缓解长程信用分配。联合训练出现明显相变：首盲通过率收敛到 99% 以上，平均回报提升约一个数量级，最终平均最高底注稳定在 8 中的第 3 级；相同奖励下，单智能体基线在贪心与囤积两种失败模式间振荡，无法稳定通过首盲。结果表明双策略分解可作为《Balatro》的强反应式基线，剩余差距主要在长程战略规划而非战术出牌。
arxiv.reason: 游戏强化学习与模拟器工程，非 LLM 方向，仅 PPO 方法略有交集

arxiv.title: When Should AI Decide, Defer, and Deviate? Responsible Automation for Deceased Donor Kidney Allocation
arxiv.abstract: We ask when an AI trained on historical decisions should be allowed to recommend decisions, defer to human experts, or in other cases, flag concerning patterns in data and deviate from past practice. This can be challenging because past decisions record what was done rather than what should have been done, and where data is sparse, a model's predictions may be too uncertain to act on. We provide a framework for addressing this problem using a case study in deceased-donor kidney allocation. Nearly 30% of kidneys recovered from deceased donors in the United States are never transplanted, largely because they are hard to place through the standard waitlist sequence. One can use AI to flag kidneys at risk of delayed or failed placement for out-of-sequence (OOS) allocation, but this comes at the cost of bypassing candidates higher on the waitlist. Thus, OOS allocation should only be used when the organ is demonstrably at high risk of discard on the standard sequence. Using Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network match-run data from 2016-2019 and 2023-2025 (excluding COVID-19-disrupted years), we build the Arbitrator framework, which combines various interpretable models and acts only when the uncertainty in their predictions cannot change the preferred action. Our Arbitrator resolves 93.5% of organ placement decisions using explicit medical criteria learned from data, and defers the remaining 6.5% to a human or a more complex model. We show that the Arbitrator correctly identifies 70.1% of historically discarded low-KDPI kidneys as OOS candidates, projecting that up to 43.9% of historically discarded kidneys could be flagged for expedited placement and potentially transplanted. We then exploit the interpretability of the Arbitrator to create an agentic audit comparing the learned rules to published clinical literature in order to flag decision-making patterns that are contentious.
arxiv.titleZh: AI 何时应决策、何时应让渡、何时应偏离?已故供体肾分配的负责任自动化
arxiv.summaryZh: 用历史决策训练的模型难以区分「做了什么」与「该做什么」，数据稀疏处预测不确定性又过高，因此需要明确 AI 何时可推荐、何时应让渡人类、何时应标记异常并偏离既往实践。以美国已故供体肾分配为案例构建 Arbitrator 框架，组合多个可解释模型，仅当预测不确定性不足以改变最优动作时才行动。基于 2016–2019 与 2023–2025 年 OPTN 匹配运行数据，该框架用从数据中学到的显式医学准则解决了 93.5% 的分配决策，其余 6.5% 交由人类或更复杂模型;它正确识别出 70.1% 历史上被丢弃的低 KDPI 肾脏为序外分配候选，预计最多 43.9% 的历史丢弃肾脏可被加急放置并可能完成移植。作者进一步利用可解释性构建 agentic 审计，将学到的规则与已发表临床文献比对，标出有争议的决策模式。
arxiv.reason: 器官分配垂直应用，不确定性感知的延迟决策机制略有借鉴价值

arxiv.title: Exponential-Nemytskii Neural Operators: Learning Field Evolution Across Step Sizes
arxiv.abstract: In variable-step operator learning, agreement at observed step sizes does not by itself determine predictions at other temporal resolutions. We propose an operator whose step-size dependence is prescribed by a first-order Duhamel approximation of semilinear dynamics. It combines exact linear propagation with a local nonlinear function of the field and its derivatives, allowing evaluation below the observation interval without supervision densely sampled across step sizes. Under suitable conditions and at fixed spatial resolution, we prove that agreement between models at two step sizes controls their prediction differences throughout a prescribed range. We also give conditions for local identifiability of both components from two step sizes, supporting interpretation of the learned structure. A latent extension applies the same construction to learned fields. We evaluate the base model on two synthetic problems and the extension on two real datasets against several baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: 指数-Nemytskii 神经算子：跨步长学习场的演化
arxiv.summaryZh: 变步长算子学习中，模型在已观测步长上一致，并不能保证在其它时间分辨率下预测正确。该方法按半线性动力学的一阶 Duhamel 近似来约束步长依赖：把精确的线性传播与场及其导数的局部非线性函数组合起来，因而无需在稠密步长上做监督，就能在观测区间以下的分辨率上评估。理论证明：在固定空间分辨率下，两个步长上的一致性能控制整个给定区间内的预测差异，并给出两个组件可局部辨识的条件；潜变量扩展把同一构造用于学习到的场。在两组合成问题与两个真实数据集上，该方法对比多个基线做了评测。
arxiv.reason: 神经算子求解 PDE 演化，与 LLM 后训练／Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: FairSplit: Decomposing the Embedding Space for Fair Classification
arxiv.abstract: Fair classification faces a twofold challenge: maintaining high classification accuracy while limiting reliance on sensitive information. Our method FairSplit achieves this by learning a decomposition of the embedding space into a Fair Space used for prediction and a Sensitive Space that isolates sensitive information. During training, the model must simultaneously learn the classification task and separate fair from sensitive information. The Sensitive Space gives sensitive attributes a destination, so the Fair Space can be used for prediction without relying on them. This decomposition is guided via a learnable mask and the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) as a measure of statistical dependence. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that the demographic parity gap is upper-bounded by both (i) the learned dimensionality of the Fair Space and (ii) the HSIC between the Fair Space and sensitive attributes. FairSplit effectively handles multiclass tasks and non-binary sensitive attributes, overcoming key limitations of existing fair classification methods. Experiments on established fairness benchmarks show that FairSplit achieves competitive accuracy-fairness trade-offs. Code is available at https://github.com/shkabrii/fairsplit.
arxiv.titleZh: FairSplit：分解嵌入空间实现公平分类
arxiv.summaryZh: 公平分类要求在保持精度的同时减少对敏感属性的依赖，而现有方法多局限于二值敏感属性与二分类任务。FairSplit 将嵌入空间显式拆分为用于预测的公平子空间与专门容纳敏感信息的敏感子空间，借助可学习掩码与 HSIC 依赖性度量引导训练，使分类器在预测时无需依赖敏感信息。理论上证明人口统计学平价差距同时受公平子空间的有效维度与公平子空间—敏感属性间 HSIC 的上界约束，并可处理多分类任务与非二值敏感属性。在常用公平性基准上取得有竞争力的精度—公平性权衡。
arxiv.reason: 公平分类的表示解耦工作，与 LLM 后训练／Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Representation Complexity Along Learning Trajectories: Trading Width for Precision and Time
arxiv.abstract: What computational role does overparameterisation play during learning? Information-plane analyses suggest that neural networks can traverse representations substantially more complex than those required by their final predictors. We explore when this transient complexity serves a computational purpose by comparing the representation complexity needed for prediction with that needed to make an unknown target statistically visible through gradient feedback. We introduce an oracle model of neural network learning and use Kolmogorov \(n\)-widths to quantify effective representation complexity. Our main technical result transfers complexity bounds from the forward representation to the corresponding gradient-query features. Combined with statistical-query lower bounds, this gives a task-agnostic lower bound on the initial effective width required for target-dependent gradient information to become detectable. For \(k\)-sparse parity in \(D\) dimensions, a known target admits an \(O(k)\)-width representation, while the general bound already implies a polynomial separation between representation and discovery. We then exploit parity's invariance under coordinatewise sign reflections to identify a sharper unsigned effective width, which removes sign distinctions invisible to the parity information channel. At a transfer-compatible measurement resolution, its critical scale is \(\widetildeΘ_k\left( D^{k-1}τ^2 \right)\), up to logarithmic factors. Thus, the representation resources required to discover a predictor can substantially exceed those required to represent it once learned. Interpreting precision through accumulation over fresh samples yields a corresponding width-time frontier. Experiments support the predicted dimension dependence and examine how optimisation and generalisation depart from this idealised frontier.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习轨迹上的表示复杂度：以宽度换取精度与时间
arxiv.summaryZh: 探讨过参数化在神经网络学习中扮演的计算角色，区分预测所需的表示复杂度与让未知目标通过梯度反馈变得统计可见所需的复杂度，并用Kolmogorov n-宽度量化有效表示复杂度，将前向表示复杂度界迁移到梯度查询特征。结合统计查询下界，给出目标相关梯度信息可检测所需初始有效宽度的任务无关下界；对D维k-稀疏parity，已知目标可用O(k)宽度表示，而发现它需多项式级更大宽度，利用坐标符号反射不变性得到更紧的无符号有效宽度临界尺度\widetildeΘ_k(D^{k-1}τ^2)。将精度解释为新鲜样本上的累积，得到宽度—时间前沿，实验验证维度依赖并考察优化与泛化如何偏离理想前沿。
arxiv.reason: 神经网络学习理论，与LLM关注方向相距较远，仅擦边

arxiv.title: Distilling the Shape of Uncertainty: What On-Policy Distillation Learns and How to Predict It
arxiv.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly adopted in the post-training of large language models. However, a stronger teacher may fail to improve the student. Prior work attributes this to a lack of new knowledge, but what that knowledge is remains unclear. We show that OPD learns not only \textit{how to branch}, i.e., which candidate tokens to consider, but also \textit{where to branch}, i.e., where to keep reasoning paths open. The existing token-overlap metric captures only the former. We introduce the entropy shape, the sequence of next-token entropies, to characterize the latter, and propose the Entropy Shape Correlation (ESC) to measure student-teacher agreement in entropy shape. Tracking ESC throughout training and intervening on a teacher's entropy while preserving its token preferences, we empirically show that \textit{where to branch} causally drives OPD gains, independently of \textit{how to branch}. Finally, we formulate OPD outcome prediction as a teacher selection task and establish an evaluation protocol for it, under which pre-OPD ESC selects the best teacher for both students and outperforms existing predictors. Code is available at https://github.com/maybenotime/opd-esc.
arxiv.titleZh: 蒸馏不确定性的形状:在线策略蒸馏学到了什么，以及如何预测它
arxiv.summaryZh: 在线策略蒸馏(OPD)中更强的教师未必带来更好的学生，已有工作将其归因于缺少新知识，却未说明知识是什么。该工作指出OPD同时学到「如何分支」(考虑哪些候选token)与「在哪里分支」(在何处保持推理路径开放)，而常用的token重叠指标只刻画前者。作者以下一token熵序列(熵形状)刻画后者，提出熵形状相关性(ESC)度量师生一致性，并在保持教师token偏好不变的前提下干预其熵，证明「在哪里分支」独立于「如何分支」因果地驱动OPD收益。最后将OPD结果预测建模为教师选择任务并给出评测协议，pre-OPD的ESC在两个学生上均选出最佳教师，优于现有预测器。
arxiv.reason: 在线策略蒸馏的机制分析与教师选择协议，直击后训练方向

arxiv.title: Author-Informed Stance Detection: A Dataset and Findings
arxiv.abstract: Stance detection in social media is challenging, as interpreting a text often requires understanding the author's perspective. We re-frame political stance detection as an author-informed text understanding task, where it is desired to infer both the author's political leaning and their stance towards the target from the text. We first show that human annotators struggle to infer authors' political leanings and stances from individual tweets, and that pretrained large language models (LLMs) perform below human level in this setting. We then demonstrate that author context improves stance detection for both humans and LLMs, with particularly pronounced benefits for tweets perceived as sarcastic. Through extensive experiments, we further show that LLMs can be effectively fine-tuned to predict authors' political affiliations, and that author-informed fine-tuning yields better stance detection performance than standard fine-tuning. This approach not only surpasses human performance but also improves generalization across datasets. To support further research on author-informed political stance detection, we release a large dataset of stance-labeled tweets enriched with author-context information.
arxiv.titleZh: 融入作者信息的立场检测:数据集与发现
arxiv.summaryZh: 单条推文的立场检测往往需要先理解作者的政治视角，而人类标注者与预训练 LLM 仅凭单条推文都难以可靠推断作者政治倾向及其对目标的立场，LLM 表现还低于人类水平。为此把政治立场检测重构为作者信息驱动的文本理解任务，要求同时推断作者政治倾向与立场，并引入作者上下文作为额外输入。实验显示作者上下文对人类与 LLM 均有增益，对被视为讽刺的推文提升尤为明显;用作者信息做微调的 LLM 在立场检测上优于标准微调，不仅超过人类表现，还提升了跨数据集泛化能力。工作同时发布了一个带立场标签与作者上下文的大规模推文数据集，供后续研究使用。
arxiv.reason: 社媒政治立场检测属垂直应用，仅沾LLM微调边

arxiv.title: Implicit Reasoning in Transformers: Bridging the Compositionality Gap in GPT-2-like Models
arxiv.abstract: Compositional generalization remains a persistent limitation of transformer language models: even when a model learns to combine known facts correctly in-distribution (ID), the same compositional mechanism may fail when applied to out-of-distribution (OOD) knowledge. We investigate this compositionality gap in a controlled two-hop reasoning setting using a GPT-2-like transformer model trained from scratch. Building on prior work identifying a circuit associated with compositional generalization, we test whether the failure of OOD transfer is related to how atomic knowledge is structurally exposed during training. We modify the training distribution by presenting both ID and OOD atomic facts in a format positionally aligned with the second-hop retrieval step of the learned compositional circuit, without modifying the model architecture or adding OOD compositional supervision. Under this intervention, the model successfully transfers the learned ID compositional behaviour to held-out OOD atomic facts, closing the observed compositionality gap in the controlled setting. Our results provide evidence that the observed compositionality gap is not a fundamental architecture limitation and that it can be overcome through mechanistically informed training distribution design.
arxiv.titleZh: Transformer中的隐式推理:弥合GPT-2类模型中的组合性差距
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对Transformer语言模型的组合泛化缺陷:模型在分布内(ID)能正确组合已知事实，但同一组合机制迁移到分布外(OOD)知识时失效。在受控两跳推理设定下从零训练GPT-2类模型，借助已有工作定位的组合泛化电路，检验OOD迁移失败是否与训练时原子知识的结构暴露方式有关。仅修改训练分布，将ID与OOD原子事实都放在与电路第二跳检索位置对齐的格式位置，不改架构、不加OOD组合监督，模型即成功把ID组合行为迁移到留出的OOD原子事实，弥合了该设定下的组合性差距。结果表明该差距并非架构固有局限，可由机制启发的训练分布设计克服。
arxiv.reason: 机制可解释性指导训练分布设计，命中推理与预训练方向

arxiv.title: Assessing feature scorer results on high-dimensional datasets with t-SNE
arxiv.abstract: While vast literature on high-dimensional data visualization is available, there are not many works regarding the visualization of feature scorers and their results. Feature scorers are algorithms that assign numerical importance to each feature of multi-dimensional datasets. These importance scores can be used in several applications, such as feature selection, knowledge discovery, and machine learning interpretability. There are several feature scorers to choose from, and often no single metric or ground truth is available to guarantee the quality of their results. In this scenario, visualization can become valuable to support the decision of which method to choose and how good its results are. For this goal, this work presents "weighted t-SNE." It modifies the relationship between data points in the embedded 2D space to reflect the importance of each dimension of the original datasets as assessed by a feature scorer. This research discusses how to implement weighted t-SNE, proposes the silhouette coefficient as a numerical evaluation of the results, and shows several examples of its use in practice. Synthetic and real-world tabular datasets are used in the experiments together with nine feature scorers, ranging from Mutual Information to neural networks. Each feature scorer produces unique visualizations, and weighted t-SNE can be used to compare and choose the one that better suits a given dataset and task. Weighted t-SNE can also visually show the importance of features learned by machine learning models and help us see how they are organizing the data, increasing their interpretability.
arxiv.titleZh: 用 t-SNE 评估高维数据集上的特征评分器结果
arxiv.summaryZh: 高维数据可视化文献很多，但针对特征评分器(为各特征赋予重要性数值的算法)结果的可视化工作很少，而且缺乏可靠的度量来判断评分质量。为此提出加权 t-SNE:在二维嵌入中修改数据点之间的关系，使原始数据集各维度按特征评分器给出的重要性加权，并引入轮廓系数作为结果的数值评估。在合成与真实表格数据上，对从互信息到神经网络的九种评分器进行实验，每种评分器都产生独特可视化，可用于比较与选择，也能展示机器学习模型学到的特征重要性如何组织数据，提升可解释性。
arxiv.reason: 表格数据特征重要性可视化，与 LLM 关注方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Fed-IGTD: A federated learning-based framework for tabular-to-image encoding
arxiv.abstract: Tabular-to-image encoding methods, which transform tabular data into image-like representations, have shown promising results in predictive tasks. Despite their benefits, these methods follow a centralized paradigm, in which the data are collected and models are trained on a central device. This raises privacy and security concerns, particularly the risk of data leakage, unauthorized data collection and access to users' private information. Federated Learning (FL) provides a decentralized framework in which multiple clients jointly optimize a shared model without directly sharing training data. We introduce Fed-IGTD, a horizontal FL-based approach in which clients share a common feature space and upload only local statistics, from which the server reconstructs the global correlation matrix and obtains a feature-to-pixel mapping to train a convolutional neural network via Federated Averaging (FedAvg). We studied two differential privacy (DP) mechanisms: (i) a one-shot Gaussian mechanism protecting the correlation-aggregation step; and (ii) a client-level DP-FedAvg variant protecting the training with privacy loss composed via a Renyi-DP accountant. We evaluated Fed-IGTD on five datasets under a systematic sweep of non-IID severity and privacy budgets. Privacy protection applied to the mapping-construction step has little impact on predictive performance. By contrast, DP-FedAvg substantially degrades utility at moderate privacy budgets with a small client cohort (K=5). Ablation study indicates that this degradation is driven mainly by the injected noise rather than by uniform averaging or update clipping. Macro-F1 exhibits sensitivity to performance degradation than accuracy under non-IID heterogeneity and class imbalance.
arxiv.titleZh: Fed-IGTD：一个基于联邦学习的表格到图像编码框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 表格到图像编码依赖集中式训练，存在隐私泄露与未授权访问风险。Fed-IGTD 采用横向联邦学习:客户端仅上传本地统计量，服务器据此重建全局相关矩阵并求解特征到像素的映射，再用 FedAvg 训练 CNN;同时评估两种差分隐私机制，一种是一次性高斯机制保护相关矩阵聚合，另一种是客户端级 DP-FedAvg 并用 Renyi-DP accountant 组合隐私损失。在五个数据集上扫描非 IID 程度与隐私预算后发现，映射构建阶段的隐私保护几乎不影响预测性能，而 DP-FedAvg 在中等隐私预算、客户端数 K=5 时性能显著下降，消融表明降级主要来自注入噪声而非均匀平均或更新裁剪;Macro-F1 比 accuracy 更能反映非 IID 与类别不平衡下的退化。适用于隐私敏感的表格数据建模场景。
arxiv.reason: 联邦学习加表格数据隐私，与 LLM 后训练、Agent 等关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Formal Specifications with Data-Driven Signal Analysis
arxiv.abstract: Developing analog and hybrid systems requires substantial domain knowledge that is hard to articulate in a formal specification; without additional effort, this domain knowledge is also inaccessible to machine learning methods. We propose a hybrid approach for analyzing and monitoring real-valued signals that integrates specification-based and data-driven techniques. We use regular expressions with interval operations to identify regions of interest in a signal, classical signal processing methods to extract semantically meaningful features, and semi-supervised machine learning to infer complex relationships that distinguish correct from faulty behaviors. The relationships learned from normal behavior data can automatically detect incorrect behavior in the same system or variants thereof. We evaluate the method on a voltage regulator, demonstrating its effectiveness in detecting undesired system behaviors.
arxiv.titleZh: 结合数据驱动信号分析的形式化规约
arxiv.summaryZh: 模拟与混合系统的正确行为难以写成形式化规约，且相关领域知识无法直接为机器学习所用。为此提出规约与数据驱动结合的方法：用带区间运算的正则表达式在实值信号中定位感兴趣区域，用经典信号处理提取有语义的特征，再用半监督学习推断区分正常与故障行为的复杂关系；从正常数据学到的关系可自动检测同一系统及其变体中的异常。在稳压器上的实验验证了该方法检测不良系统行为的有效性。
arxiv.reason: 形式化规约与信号处理结合，属系统监控，与LLM各方向无关

arxiv.title: Blind Spots: Where Small Language Models Fall Behind Frontier Models on Terminal Tasks
arxiv.abstract: Small language models (SLMs) offer an attractive alternative to frontier models (FMs) because they can be deployed with lower cost and latency. This makes SLMs especially appealing for terminal tasks on edge devices, where responsiveness, local execution, and limited connectivity are important considerations. However, they continue to lag behind FMs on terminal tasks, as measured by standard task success rates. Yet these rates conflate several capabilities that may contribute to this gap. In this work, we characterize the SLM-FM gap along three axes: solvability, whether additional test-time compute allows an SLM to reach a correct solution; verification, whether it can identify a successful solution among candidate trajectories; and confidence, whether it can accurately anticipate its probability of success. Across two standard terminal benchmarks, we find that repeated sampling narrows, but does not eliminate, the gap in solvability. In contrast, a persistent gap remains in verification. Given the same candidate trajectory pool, FMs recover substantially more of the gap between random and oracle selection than SLMs. SLMs are also more overconfident in their prospective success estimates and exhibit poorer calibration. These results suggest that the SLM-FM gap is multidimensional, spanning not only the ability to generate successful solutions, but also the ability to recognize successful solutions and anticipate success. We hope this decomposition can guide future work on developing stronger and smaller terminal agents.
arxiv.titleZh: 盲区：小模型在终端任务上落后于前沿模型之处
arxiv.summaryZh: 小模型在终端（terminal）任务上、按任务成功率衡量的差距，究竟来自能力不足还是自我评估不足，尚不清楚。该工作将小模型与前沿模型的差距拆为三维：可解性（增加测试时计算能否得到正确解）、验证（能否在候选轨迹中识别出成功解）、置信度（能否准确预判自身成功率），并在两个标准终端 benchmark 上做系统对照。结果显示，重复采样只能缩小、不能消除可解性差距；验证差距则持续存在——在相同候选轨迹池下，前沿模型从随机选择到 oracle 选择之间挽回的比例显著高于小模型；小模型的前瞻成功率估计更过度自信、校准更差。结论是差距是多维的，不只是能否生成解，还包括能否识别解与预判成功，为构建更强更小的终端 Agent 指明了改进方向。
arxiv.reason: 终端Agent能力分解评测，验证与校准分析扎实，贴合Agent方向

arxiv.title: How Architecture, Typology, and Adaptation Strategies Shape ASR for Low-Resource African Languages: A Controlled Empirical Study
arxiv.abstract: Despite recent advancements in ASR, identifying effective architectures, fine-tuning approaches, and data adaptation strategies for low-resource languages remains challenging. We present a systematic comparison across five low-resource African languages and Swahili as a mid-resource contrast, fine-tuning three models from distinct architectures: Phi-4-multimodal-instruct, Whisper-large-v3-turbo, and MMS-1B-all. We analyze data sufficiency, monolingual versus multilingual adaptation, domain fine-tuning, and language-adapter transfer. Phi-4 achieves the best overall accuracy, MMS shows comparable CER, while Whisper exhibits high CER, consistent with known hallucinations and repetition loops. Performance saturates at different data scales, offering practical data-efficiency targets, while typological complexity consistently shapes error rates. Domain fine-tuning benefits Phi-4 and Whisper but degrades MMS, revealing limitations of adapter-based adaptation. Proxy language adapters outperform training MMS adapters from scratch.
arxiv.titleZh: 架构、类型学与适应策略如何塑造低资源非洲语言的 ASR：一项受控实证研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 低资源语言的 ASR 在架构选型、微调方式与数据适应策略上仍缺乏系统结论。研究在五种低资源非洲语言上做受控对比，并以斯瓦希里语作为中等资源参照，微调 Phi-4-multimodal-instruct、Whisper-large-v3-turbo 与 MMS-1B-all 三种不同架构模型，考察数据充分度、单语与多语适应、领域微调及语言适配器迁移。结果显示 Phi-4 整体准确率最佳，MMS 的 CER 与之接近，Whisper 因幻觉与重复循环导致 CER 偏高；不同模型的数据饱和点不同，可给出数据效率目标，类型学复杂度持续影响错误率；领域微调对 Phi-4 与 Whisper 有益却使 MMS 退化，代理语言适配器优于从零训练 MMS 适配器。
arxiv.reason: 低资源语音识别实证研究，属语音应用方向，仅与多模态模型微调略沾边

arxiv.title: Agentic AI Reasoning and Learned Sampling for Task-Aware Projection Selection in Sparse-View CT: Predicting Hemodynamics
arxiv.abstract: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reduces the number of acquired projections, but conventional sampling strategies are designed primarily for image reconstruction rather than for downstream physical inference. Here, we investigate optimal task-aware projection selection for directly predicting hemodynamics from sparse CT angiography (CTA) measurements. Using computational fluid dynamics simulations of intracranial aneurysms, we generate synthetic fan-beam CTA projections and train a Fourier neural operator (FNO) to predict two targets: the spatially resolved time-averaged wall shear stress (TAWSS) field and the spatially averaged TAWSS. The FNO was coupled with optimal input selection for simultaneous optimal sampling and training. Our goal was to investigate if agentic AI could discover optimal sampling strategies that outperform current methods. We compared fixed uniform and golden-angle sampling with three task-aware optimal selection strategies: Gumbel-Softmax, a Soft top-K method, and an agentic AI selector. The methods were compared at different view selection budgets. A detailed analysis of the AI agent was performed to understand its reasoning and performance. For spatially resolved TAWSS, Agentic and Soft top-K achieve the lowest mean errors (Agentic performs slightly better) and substantially outperform fixed sampling under extreme sparsity. For spatially averaged TAWSS, optimized selection becomes important at extremely sparse acquisitions. Analysis of the selected masks reveals multiple distinct subsets concentrated around informative regions. Moreover, masks optimized for hemodynamic prediction yield poor image reconstructions, showing that task-optimal acquisition differs fundamentally from reconstruction-optimal acquisition. This work suggests the possibility of designing sparse acquisitions directly around downstream physical quantities.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向稀疏视角 CT 任务感知投影选择的 Agentic AI 推理与学习采样:预测血流动力学
arxiv.summaryZh: 稀疏视角 CT 的采样策略通常为图像重建而设计，并不面向下游物理量推断。该工作基于颅内动脉瘤的 CFD 仿真生成合成扇形束 CTA 投影，训练 Fourier 神经算子(FNO)直接从稀疏投影预测时间平均壁面剪应力(TAWSS)场与其空间均值，并将输入选择与训练联合优化;在不同视角预算下比较固定均匀采样、黄金角采样与三种任务感知选择策略(Gumbel-Softmax、Soft top-K 与 Agentic AI 选择器)。结果显示，空间分辨 TAWSS 预测中 Agentic 与 Soft top-K 误差最低，极端稀疏条件下显著优于固定采样;而为血流动力学优化的掩码所重建的图像质量很差，说明任务最优采集与重建最优采集存在本质差异。
arxiv.reason: 医疗影像血流动力学应用，仅 Agentic 采样略沾边

arxiv.title: Rethinking GFlowNet Training: Negative Reinforce Dynamics
arxiv.abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are models that learn to sample discrete objects proportional to a target reward. They are trained by minimizing balance errors over sampled trajectories, which inherently ties correctness to exploration: if a region is not visited, balance cannot be enforced there. Adaptive exploration is therefore crucial, yet standard training relies on a semi-gradient update that treats the sampling distribution as fixed at each optimization step. On the other hand, the full gradient reveals a second mechanism that reduces the observed errors in an anti-exploratory manner. In this paper, we establish a connection between the full gradient and min-min dynamics between the GFlowNet and a decoupled sampler, showing that the sampler reduces observed violations by avoiding high-error regions. This insight motivates a bridge between two-player games and single-policy dynamics, which underpins the design of our proposed method, Negative Reinforce Dynamics (NRD). By tying the parameters of an adversarial game together, we recover a single-policy dynamic that extends exploration while maintaining correctness. In standard benchmarks, our method outperforms existing approaches in both convergence speed and exploration efficiency, without training a separate teacher or auxiliary exploration policy.
arxiv.titleZh: 重新审视 GFlowNet 训练:负 Reinforce 动力学
arxiv.summaryZh: GFlowNet 依赖在采样轨迹上最小化平衡误差来学习按奖励比例采样，而半梯度更新在每一步把采样分布视为固定，使正确性与探索深度耦合:未访问区域无法施加约束。本文把全梯度解释为 GFlowNet 与解耦采样器之间的 min-min 动力学，采样器通过回避高误差区域来降低观测到的违例，从而在双人博弈与单策略动力学之间架起桥梁。据此提出 Negative Reinforce Dynamics(NRD)，将对抗博弈的参数绑定在一起，得到在保持正确性的同时扩展探索的单策略动态。标准 benchmark 上其收敛速度与探索效率均优于现有方法，且无需额外训练 teacher 或辅助探索策略。
arxiv.reason: GFlowNet 训练动力学，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向仅间接相关

arxiv.title: Syntactic Segmentation and Collage Generation for Videogame Levels with Perceptual Distance
arxiv.abstract: In procedural videogame level design, many existing techniques combine hand-authored level chunks. Some existing analysis techniques also rely on a higher-level graph structure which abstracts the level design. In this paper, we explore techniques for computing both of these things automatically from an existing design. We introduce the concept of perceptual distance, based on analysis techniques from the architecture subfield of Space Syntax. We use this perceptual distance to segment level designs with hierarchical clustering. We compare with past work on StarCraft analysis, show results on rooms from Super Metroid, and also demonstrate a proof-of-concept level generation algorithm based on this segmentation method.
arxiv.comment: 11 pages, 12 figures, 22nd Artificial Intelligence and Interactive Digital Entertainment Conference
arxiv.titleZh: 面向电子游戏关卡、基于感知距离的句法分割与拼贴生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对程序化游戏关卡设计依赖手工关卡块、分析又依赖高层图抽象的问题，提出从已有设计中自动计算两者的方法:借鉴建筑学 Space Syntax 分析定义「感知距离」，并用层次聚类据此对关卡做句法分割;在 StarCraft 关卡分析上与已有工作对比，在《Super Metroid》的房间上展示分割结果，并给出基于该分割的关卡拼贴生成原型。适用于程序化内容生成与关卡结构分析场景。
arxiv.reason: 游戏关卡程序化生成，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Benchmarking Graph Neural Networks for AC Power Flow: The Role of Inductive Biases and Physical Constraints
arxiv.abstract: Fast and accurate models for AC power flow (ACPF) are increasingly important as modern electrical grids require more frequent system analyses. Graph neural networks (GNNs) naturally exploit electrical grid topology, yet the effects of architectural design choices on predictive performance remain poorly understood given differences in graph representations and evaluation settings across studies. We present a unified benchmark of representative GNN architectures for ACPF prediction under a common experimental framework. All models use identical preprocessing and training procedures and comparable parameter budgets, isolating the impact of message-passing mechanisms and inductive biases. We also analyze errors by distance from the slack bus and systematically ablate key design components. We evaluate predictive accuracy and physical consistency on the IEEE 14-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems. Results indicate that anisotropic message-passing architectures offer the most favorable trade-off between predictive accuracy and physical consistency under the studied parameter and topology constraints. Explicit edge features encoding line impedances and global context aggregation are particularly important for representing electrical interactions and system-wide dependencies, especially for voltage-angle predictions on the topologically bottlenecked IEEE-118 grid. Under a budget with approximately fixed parameters, two or three message-passing layers generally provide the best balance between depth and representation width, while additional depth offers no consistent improvement. Ablations also show that standard residual and root connections are not necessarily beneficial in shallow models, and that aggregation operators involve trade-offs between statistical accuracy and physical consistency. These results provide practical guidelines for designing graph-based power system models.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向交流潮流的图神经网络基准评测:归纳偏置与物理约束的作用
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对交流潮流(ACPF)预测中图神经网络设计选择影响不明、各研究图表示与评测设置不一致的问题，构建统一基准，在相同预处理、训练流程与相近参数预算下比较代表性 GNN 架构，隔离消息传递机制与归纳偏置的作用，并按离平衡节点距离分析误差、消融关键组件。在 IEEE 14 与 IEEE 118 节点系统上同时评测预测精度与物理一致性，发现各向异性消息传递在两者间权衡最优;编码线路阻抗的显式边特征与全局上下文聚合对电压相角预测尤为关键，在拓扑受限的 118 节点系统上更明显;固定参数预算下 2–3 层消息传递最优，继续加深无一致收益，浅层模型中残差与根连接并非必然有益，聚合算子则在统计精度与物理一致性间存在取舍。
arxiv.reason: 电力系统 GNN 基准，属垂直行业应用，与 LLM 关注方向无关

arxiv.title: Why Speculative Decoding Works Better Than Predicted on Sparse MoE Models
arxiv.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive inference by leveraging the memory bound nature of decoding, verifying multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. For mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, prior work predicts a concave speedup-batch size relationship, with gains peaking at intermediate batch sizes due to expert saturation. We evaluate this across 10 sparse MoE models (30B--1T parameters, 8--512 experts) and find recent fine-grained models break this trend, showing higher speedup at low batch size. We find verification cost is governed not only by activated-expert bytes, but also by temporal overlap across draft tokens and GPU execution dynamics. At low batch size, MoE layers in fine-grained models account for a much smaller share of runtime than of weights; on H100, kernel profiling attributes this mainly to higher bandwidth utilization of MoE kernels relative to attention, with L2 absorbing repeated reads of co-routed experts. Across draft tokens, routing overlap further reduces the unique experts activated during verification relative to independence assumptions. We model this effect using a maximum-entropy Iterative Proportional Fitting (IPF) framework that predicts unique expert counts from routing-overlap statistics with less than 4\% error, and substantially narrows the gap to real-model curves and captures the qualitative low-batch trend from synthetic routing.
arxiv.comment: Accepted as at NeurIPS 2026 main track conference
arxiv.titleZh: 为什么投机解码在稀疏 MoE 模型上比预期更有效
arxiv.summaryZh: 既有工作预测 MoE 上投机解码的加速比随 batch size 呈凹形、在中等 batch 触顶，原因是专家饱和。该结论在 10 个稀疏 MoE 模型(30B–1T 参数、8–512 专家)上被系统检验并推翻:细粒度 MoE 在低 batch 反而加速更高。H100 上的 kernel profiling 表明验证开销不只由激活专家字节数决定，还受 MoE 与 attention 带宽利用率差异、L2 对共路由专家重复读的吸收以及 draft token 间路由重叠影响;并用最大熵迭代比例拟合(IPF)从路由重叠统计预测唯一专家数，误差低于 4%，显著缩小与真实模型曲线的差距。结果可直接指导 MoE 服务中投机解码的 batch 配置与草稿长度选择。
arxiv.reason: 投机解码与 MoE 推理效率的系统性分析，扎实命中效率方向

arxiv.title: Context Compaction for World Models
arxiv.abstract: World models let observers explore and interact with generated worlds. Recent work shows that when observers revisit a region, current models often fail to regenerate it consistently. We view this as a context retrieval problem. LLM agents manage context retrieval at two layers of their stack. At the model layer, the KV cache design determines how much context fits in memory. At the agent harness layer, harnesses such as Claude Code pick the context sent to the LLM. Prior work on world models has mostly focused only on the model layer. In this paper, we make three contributions. First, we build a benchmark to measure world model context retrieval. It generates new worlds for every episode, preventing a model from recalling rooms using training data. It also separates context retrieval from guesses based on nearby frames. Second, we build an agent harness that performs context compaction for world models, which to our knowledge no prior work has studied. Third, we use our benchmark to study four world model designs. Context compaction lets our world models retrieve rooms up to 4 times beyond their context window without retraining. However, world models with sliding-window attention lose most of their context retrieval when dreaming. Therefore, a dreaming world agent benefits more from extending the reach of its world model using context compaction than switching to sliding window attention at the model layer.
arxiv.titleZh: 世界模型的上下文压缩
arxiv.summaryZh: 世界模型在被重访同一区域时常常无法一致地重建该区域，这一问题被重新表述为上下文检索：在模型层，KV cache 的容量决定能容纳多少上下文；在 agent harness 层，harness 决定把哪些上下文送入模型；而此前的工作只关注模型层。为此，作者构建了一个评测基准，它在每回合生成新世界，并把上下文检索与基于邻近帧的猜测区分开；还实现了一个面向世界模型的上下文压缩 harness；并用该基准对比四种世界模型设计。上下文压缩使世界模型无需重训练，就能检索到超出其上下文窗口至多 4 倍的房间；但采用滑动窗口注意力的世界模型在 dreaming 时几乎丧失检索能力，因此扩展压缩比在模型层改用滑动窗口注意力更划算。
arxiv.reason: 世界模型上下文检索，涉及 agent harness 与 KV cache，但主题属视觉生成

arxiv.title: Beyond Passing Tests: A Systematic Review and Controlled Re-evaluation of Techniques for Improving the Quality of LLM-Generated Code
arxiv.abstract: Large language models pass most functional-correctness benchmarks, but passing tests says little about whether their code is readable, efficient or secure. Many techniques claim to improve these qualities, yet their evidence is scattered, usually covers one quality dimension and is rarely compared at an equal compute budget. We contribute a systematic review and a controlled re-evaluation. A systematic literature review of 628 primary studies (July 2021 to October 2026), with disclosed, author-reviewed LLM assistance, organizes the techniques by stage, signal source and quality target. Most studies measure only the dimension they target, gains often come with unchanged or unreported correctness, single automated quality signals are gamed, and compute, variance and contamination are rarely reported. A controlled re-evaluation runs ten techniques on four models at matched budgets on correctness, maintainability, efficiency and security benchmarks, extends it to thirteen current models and repository-level tasks, and compares 66 highlighted techniques head-to-head on Gemma 4 31B. At one call, quality prompting raises analyzer issue counts and leaves complexity and judge scores almost unchanged. At matched budgets, best-of-n sampling with an analyzer-weighted ranker matches or beats prompting, planning, self-refinement, a reviewer agent and retrieval on measures the ranker does not optimize, while an analyzer feedback loop and fine-tuning beat it only on analyzer issue counts. Large correctness losses on HumanEval+, a likely contaminated benchmark near its ceiling, do not appear on contests held after the models' training cutoffs. In the head-to-head, 1 of 66 techniques beats best-of-n on its primary target beyond the 95% interval, a rate consistent with chance. Gains should be reported against a budget-matched sampling baseline and on measures independent of the technique's own signal.
arxiv.comment: 55 pages, 5 figures, plus 120 pages of supplementary material
arxiv.titleZh: 超越通过测试：LLM生成代码质量提升技术的系统综述与受控重评估
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM生成代码通过功能测试并不等于可读、高效或安全，而改进技术多在单一维度、不等算力下评估。工作含628篇原始研究的系统综述（2021年7月至2026年10月），并在匹配预算下用4个模型重评10种技术、覆盖正确性、可维护性、效率与安全，再扩展到13个模型与仓库级任务，在Gemma 4 31B上对66种技术头对头比较。结果显示质量提示在单次调用下反而抬高分析器告警数；分析器加权排序的best-of-n在排序器未优化的指标上追平或超过提示、规划、自我精炼、评审Agent与检索；66种技术中仅1种以超过95%区间胜出。主张以预算匹配的采样基线与独立于技术信号的指标报告增益。

arxiv.title: The Utility of Physics-Informed Machine Learning in Solar Power Production Forecasting
arxiv.abstract: Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and hybrid modeling have attracted significant attention as approaches for combining physical knowledge with the flexibility of deep learning. In this work, we investigate whether these approaches deliver their commonly claimed benefits for large-scale photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting. We develop two hybrid forecasting architectures that integrate the ADR physical PV efficiency model with the TSMixer neural forecasting architecture through feature augmentation and residual learning. The proposed models are evaluated on a dataset comprising over 3 million samples from 3,713 PV installations across 33 European countries. We assess convergence speed, forecasting accuracy, transferability across geographical regions, and data efficiency. Although the physics-informed models seem to exhibit slightly faster convergence during training, they do not achieve consistent improvements in test-set accuracy, generalization, or performance under limited training data compared to the purely data-driven baseline. These findings suggest that, for modern deep forecasting architectures trained on large datasets, explicitly incorporating the ADR physical model provides limited practical benefit for day-ahead PV forecasting.
arxiv.titleZh: 物理信息机器学习在光伏发电功率预测中的效用
arxiv.summaryZh: 检验物理信息机器学习与混合建模在大规模光伏功率预测中是否真能兑现常被宣称的收益。将 ADR 物理光伏效率模型与 TSMixer 神经预测架构通过特征增广与残差学习结合，构建两种混合架构，并在覆盖 33 个欧洲国家、3713 个光伏电站、超过 300 万样本的数据集上评估收敛速度、预测精度、跨区域迁移性与数据效率。结果显示物理信息模型训练收敛略快，但在测试集精度、泛化与少数据条件下均未相较纯数据驱动基线取得一致提升，表明对大规模数据训练的现代深度预测架构而言，显式引入 ADR 物理模型对日前光伏预测的实际收益有限。
arxiv.reason: 光伏功率预测属能源垂类应用，与 LLM 关注方向无关

arxiv.title: Dungeons & Dragons Encounter Analysis with Semi-Random Simulation in Foundry VTT
arxiv.abstract: Dungeons & Dragons (D&D) is a tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) in which a group of players, guided by a Game Master, roleplay a fantasy adventure with simulated combat and improvisational narrative. In D&D, an encounter is a single instance of simulated combat, where the players must use their characters to attempt to defeat a selection of enemy characters that the GM controls. D&D has multiple systems that approximate encounter difficulty by summing individual difficulty values that designers predefine for each enemy. However, since players and enemies can have a wide variety of capabilities, encounter difficulty depends on more than just the estimated difficulty of each monster. For example, these metrics do not account for positioning and dungeon layout, the synergies between monster abilities, and player party composition. We have created a tool, Mage-Hand, that can simulate D&D encounters semi-randomly using Foundry Virtual Tabletop, a virtual tabletop (VTT) system. In this paper, we show that our tool's simulated winrates have a strong correlation with D&D's published difficulty evaluation metrics, while also better aligning with some players' reported experiences.
arxiv.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 22nd Artificial Intelligence and Interactive Digital Entertainment Conference
arxiv.titleZh: 《龙与地下城》遭遇战分析与 Foundry VTT 中的半随机模拟
arxiv.summaryZh: 官方遭遇难度指标只是把每只怪物的预设难度值相加，无法反映站位与地城布局、怪物能力之间的协同以及玩家队伍构成，因此常与实际体验不符。Mage-Hand 工具在 Foundry 虚拟桌面(VTT)上以半随机方式驱动战斗模拟，批量跑出遭遇战胜率。结果显示模拟胜率与官方难度指标存在强相关，同时更贴合部分玩家主观报告的难度感受，可作为地下城主设计遭遇战的辅助评估手段。
arxiv.reason: 桌面角色扮演游戏的战斗模拟工具，与 LLM 及后训练方向无交集

arxiv.title: Communication-Efficient Clustered Federated Learning in Non-IID Wireless Networks
arxiv.abstract: Current and emerging mobile networks face increasing privacy, scalability, and performance challenges as distributed learning becomes essential for advanced 6G services. These challenges are amplified by the presence of non-IID data, naturally arising in heterogeneous wireless environments, that degrade the performance of standard Federated Learning (FL) approaches. To address non-IID data across clients, we propose a Clustered Federated Learning (CFL) framework that assigns clients to specialized models during training. Data-domain clustering initializes model-based clustering, enabling identification and exploitation of client similarities without sharing raw data while reducing communication cost. Motivated by mmWave beam selection, we evaluate our methods on a wireless simulation dataset (DeepMIMO) and complement it with two non-IID benchmarks (FEMNIST, Rotated CIFAR-10) to isolate different non-IID characteristics. Our best configurations improve accuracy over IFCA by 4.8 pp on DeepMIMO and 10.6 pp on FEMNIST while reducing downlink data volume by 83.1 % on FEMNIST compared to IFCA. We demonstrate that different clustering strategies suit different non-IID characteristics. These results show that our CFL methods enable resource-efficient, and high-performance distributed learning in future 6G networks.
arxiv.titleZh: 非IID无线网络中的通信高效聚类联邦学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向6G无线网络中客户端数据非IID导致标准联邦学习性能退化的问题，提出聚类联邦学习框架:先用数据域聚类初始化基于模型的聚类，在不共享原始数据的前提下识别并利用客户端相似性，同时降低通信开销;以毫米波波束选择为动机，在DeepMIMO仿真数据与FEMNIST、Rotated CIFAR-10两个非IID基准上验证。最优配置相对IFCA在DeepMIMO上提升4.8个百分点、FEMNIST上提升10.6个百分点，并在FEMNIST上把下行数据量减少83.1%。结果表明不同聚类策略适配不同的非IID特性，为6G网络中的资源高效分布式学习提供方案。
arxiv.reason: 联邦学习+无线网络垂直应用，与LLM后训练/Agent主线无交集

arxiv.title: Efficient Agentic Audio-Visual Question Answering through Toolset Pruning and Modality Consolidation
arxiv.abstract: Fine-grained audio-visual question answering (AVQA) requires models to resolve complex cross-modal correspondences and temporally grounding from sparsely distributed evidence. Omni-modal agents, which autonomously orchestrate perception tools to actively collect evidence, achieve strong performance, but it remains unclear whether active perception from both audio and visual modalities depends on broad specialized toolsets, especially audio or visual modality-specific tools. Such systems may also introduce long execution trajectories and substantial inference cost. We investigate whether comparable performance can be retained with a compact workflow exposing only essential perceptual capabilities. Starting from the specialized-tool OmniAgent, we conduct staged controlled experiments that prune the toolset and progressively consolidate modality-specific tools into omni-modal tools, motivating a two-tool agent comprising only Omni-modal captioning and Omni-modal QA. Across three widely used AVQA benchmarks, our compact agent achieves comparable or better accuracy than the specialized-tool agent while reducing inference cost by around 70%.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过工具集剪枝与模态整合实现高效的智能体音视频问答
arxiv.summaryZh: 细粒度音视频问答需要从稀疏分布的证据中解析跨模态对应关系并完成时间定位，而依靠 Omni 模态智能体自主编排感知工具虽效果好，却带来冗长执行轨迹与高昂推理成本。该工作从专用工具的 OmniAgent 出发，通过分阶段受控实验逐步剪枝工具集，并将各模态专用工具整合为 Omni 模态工具，最终得到一个仅含 Omni 模态描述与 Omni 模态问答两个工具的紧凑流程。在三个常用 AVQA benchmark 上，该紧凑智能体精度与专用工具版本相当或更优，同时推理成本降低约 70%。结论表明主动感知的关键在于少量跨模态工具而非广泛专用工具集，对多模态 Agent 的工具与成本设计有参考价值。
