arxiv.title: Planned Restlessness: Delayed Meta Bandits with Budgets
arxiv.abstract: We study episodic finite-horizon Bayesian bandits, or meta-bandits, with independent arms. Each episode draws fresh arm qualities from unknown recurring priors. Observations arrive after known delays, and plays obey hard per-episode caps and total budgets. A play earns reward and informs both the current quality and the recurring prior: the learner must explore, use, and generalize. We formulate a common planning optimization over learning trajectories. Its LP relaxation values experiments through current reward, resource consumption and continuation: the value of future decisions from the learning state produced. Dual prices separate the arms into local programs and certify every admissible policy, including hierarchical Thompson sampling. Execution enforces the hard constraints while preserving the promised learning transitions or accounting for their loss. The framework also represents risk-sensitive objectives and prices purchased observations and buyout options. Delayed reports create planned restlessness: an arm's information changes while it is not played, through reports of its own earlier plays arriving on a known calendar. For stationary priors, finite reward alphabets, bounded report lag and nonbinding budgets, posterior sampling over the recurring priors bounds the price of not knowing them by $O(\sqrt{N})$ over $N$ episodes, with other parameters fixed. For one undelayed $T$-step episode with arms capped at $T/X$ plays each, we obtain the LP-relative approximation factor $1+(2πX)^{-1/2}+O(X^{-1})$, improving previous factors, with a matching lower bound for the leading term.
arxiv.titleZh: 计划性不安分：带预算的延迟元赌博机
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究回合制有限时域贝叶斯赌博机（元赌博机）：每回合从未知但会重现的先验中抽取臂质量，观测在已知延迟后到达，并且每回合有硬性次数上限与总预算约束。把学习轨迹上的规划统一写成一个优化问题，其 LP 松弛用当前奖励、资源消耗与延续价值（即学习状态带来的未来决策价值）来给实验定价，对偶价格将各臂分解为局部程序并为包括分层 Thompson sampling 在内的策略提供认证；延迟回报带来「计划性不安分」——臂未被拉动时其信息仍因自身早先拉动所产生报告的到达而改变。对平稳先验、有限奖励字母表、有界报告延迟与非紧预算，对重现先验做后验采样可将「不知道先验」的代价界定在 O(√N)；对单回合无延迟 T 步、每臂上限 T/X 次的情形，得到 LP 相对近似因子 1+(2πX)^{-1/2}+O(X^{-1})，优于先前结果且首项有匹配下界。
arxiv.reason: 纯赌博机/LP 理论，无 LLM 关联，仅与 RL 基础沾边

arxiv.title: MAS-Loop: Beyond One-Shot Orchestration towards Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: Training-time multi-agent system (MAS) design seeks to learn reusable orchestration policies, yet prevailing approaches remain largely one-shot: an Orchestrator generates a system but only observes and learns from its terminal outcome. This paradigm discards execution trajectories that expose system-level failures and contain fine-grained information beyond the terminal outcome, leaving no direct basis for revising the source MAS, evaluating the updated MAS, or learning from the resulting contrast. To this end, we introduce MAS-Loop, an execution-grounded framework that closes this feedback loop by coupling an Orchestrator with a trajectory-conditioned Refiner. For each task, the Orchestrator constructs and executes a source MAS to obtain an outcome score and an intermediate trajectory. Conditioned on the trajectory, the Refiner localizes an actionable failure, formulates a trajectory-grounded diagnosis, and proposes a bounded patch to the agents, information flow, or execution configuration. The executable updated MAS is re-executed on the same task to measure its realized outcome under stochastic execution. This pair-MAS comparison provides complementary learning signals: the Orchestrator learns to generate strong systems with fewer recoverable failures, whereas the Refiner learns to expose and repair observed weaknesses, thereby driving policy-level co-evolution across training iterations. Experiments show that MAS-Loop achieves the strongest overall performance among the evaluated baselines, with consistent gains from refinement across all evaluated benchmarks. The co-evolution process also yields MAS-JudgeCorpus, a dataset of execution-grounded source-updated pairs with orchestration- and trajectory-level supervision, which can provide the community with support for MAS reward modeling and trajectory-aware investigation.
arxiv.titleZh: MAS-Loop：超越一次性编排，迈向自演进的多智能体系统
arxiv.summaryZh: 训练时的多智能体系统设计旨在学得可复用的编排策略，但现有做法多为一次性生成：Orchestrator 只依据终端结果学习，丢弃了暴露系统级失败与细粒度信息的执行轨迹。MAS-Loop 将 Orchestrator 与轨迹条件化的 Refiner 耦合成闭环：Refiner 依据中间轨迹定位可操作的失败、给出有轨迹依据的诊断，并对智能体、信息流或执行配置提出有界补丁；更新后的 MAS 在同一任务上重新执行，通过源系统与更新系统的配对比较提供互补学习信号，使 Orchestrator 学会减少可恢复失败、Refiner 学会暴露并修复弱点，实现策略层面的协同演化。实验显示其在所评估基线中总体性能最强，且精修在各基准上均带来稳定增益；协同演化过程还产出 MAS-JudgeCorpus，包含带编排级与轨迹级监督的源—更新执行配对，可供 MAS 奖励建模与轨迹感知研究使用。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体自演进＋轨迹级精修闭环，直接命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: TreasuryQA Bench: Can AI Agents Work an Archive of Scanned Financial Records?
arxiv.abstract: Organisations keep decades of financial records as scanned PDFs on shared drives, and AI agents can now reach those drives through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Existing benchmarks do not mirror this production setting because they simplify the task. In some, the relevant documents are handed to the agent, so it never has to search. In others, the agent searches through documents with pre-extracted text, so it never has to read scanned images. We introduce TreasuryQA Bench, which requires both: 70 questions over 1,435 scanned U.S. Treasury publications, held in Veris's high-fidelity Dropbox twin. In each task the agent searches for the relevant file through Dropbox's MCP server, reads the pages it needs with Reducto's hosted OCR server or its own tools, and replies with one exact figure. A Python grader checks each answer against an accepted range around the correct value. In this paper we present results from ten agents. The best, Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code, solves 64.8% of attempts and the worst, GPT-5.6 Terra in Codex, solves 16.7%, so the benchmark is far from saturated. We also test how scan quality affects performance: every agent solves fewer tasks on the blurriest scans. Most failed attempts reply with a wrong number rather than no number, and the most common cause is a digit misread from the scan. Three worked examples are included with their answer keys.
arxiv.titleZh: TreasuryQA Bench：AI Agent 能处理扫描版财务档案库吗？
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 Agent 基准简化了真实档案场景：要么直接把相关文档交给模型，要么只提供预抽取文本，因而绕过了检索与读扫描件两个关键环节。TreasuryQA Bench 构建 70 道题，覆盖 1,435 份美国财政部扫描出版物，置于 Dropbox 高保真镜像中，Agent 需经 MCP 服务器检索文件、用托管 OCR 服务或自有工具读页，最后给出唯一精确数字，由 Python 判分器按容差区间核对。十个 Agent 中最好的 Claude Opus 5.5 在 Claude Code 里解决 64.8%，最差仅 16.7%；扫描越模糊所有 Agent 表现越差，失败多为读数错误而非拒答。
arxiv.reason: Agent 工具调用与基准设计扎实，命中 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Lev-3B: A Data Recipe for Compact Probabilistic Log Decision Models
arxiv.abstract: Many log-analysis tasks involve choosing among known options, such as detecting anomalous sessions or identifying attack techniques, and benefit from calibrated probabilities. We present Lev-3B, an open 3B-parameter decision model built on Granite-4.1-3B-Base with a shared pointer readout, and study its training recipe. The recipe has two key parts. First, training follows a curriculum: the model learns bounded natural-language decisions, using no log data, before it sees any logs. Second, the log stage mixes the target tasks with general log data spanning 35 auxiliary tasks unrelated to either evaluation task. We evaluate one shared checkpoint on sources seen in training and on sources excluded from training, calibration and model selection. The two-stage recipe transfers substantially better than training on log data alone. Adding general log data improves performance on excluded sources. At a fraction of their serving cost, Lev-3B outperforms prompted frontier models on anomaly detection, including on an excluded logging system, but trails them on attack-technique classification. Its probabilities are well calibrated on familiar sources, but on the excluded logging system it confidently misses anomalies. We release the checkpoint, recipe, data manifests, and prediction-level artifacts.
arxiv.titleZh: Lev-3B：面向紧凑概率化日志决策模型的数据配方
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向日志分析中「从已知选项中做选择」且需输出校准概率的任务（如异常会话检测、攻击技术识别），基于 Granite-4.1-3B-Base 与共享指针读出构建 3B 决策模型，并系统研究其训练配方：先用不含日志数据的课程学习有界自然语言决策，再把目标任务与覆盖 35 个辅助任务的一般日志数据混合训练。同一个 checkpoint 在训练内与排除日志源上评测，两阶段配方的迁移显著优于仅用日志训练，加入一般日志数据还提升排除源上的表现；异常检测以远低于前沿模型的成本超过提示式前沿模型（含未见日志系统），攻击技术分类仍落后，概率在熟悉源上校准良好，但在未见系统上高置信漏检。
arxiv.reason: 日志分析垂直应用，但训练配方与校准分析有一定借鉴价值

arxiv.title: Interventional Training Reduces Causal Bypass in In-Context Introspection
arxiv.abstract: Introspection, the ability of a system to access and reason about its internal signals, is crucial for language model (LM) self-consistency and scalable interpretability. Prior work argues that LMs possess introspective capabilities, and that training (SFT) could enhance such behavior. However, most setups leave open the possibility of "causal bypass," in which the self-report relies on signals that are correlated with the self-report's subject, while being causally unrelated to it. Although high-level concepts are difficult to intervene on, lower-level signals (such as a single neuron activation) allow precise interventions. Understanding such signals can serve as a minimal prerequisite before understanding more complex introspection. In this study, we train hundreds of introspectors across three low-level signal types and eight LMs. We find that straightforward SFT training leads to causal bypass, and propose interventional training, an alternative where we train the model to report on counterfactually perturbed values. This method enables more accurate introspection of endogenous $\textit{and}$ injected signals, particularly in out-of-distribution (OOD) data. The mechanism generalizes across token positions and scales with more data. Our results demonstrate that while causally grounded introspection is possible, it is not guaranteed -- emphasizing the need to train on mechanisms, rather than behaviors alone.
arxiv.titleZh: 干预式训练减少上下文内省中的因果绕过
arxiv.summaryZh: 语言模型的内省自述可能依赖与目标信号仅相关、并无因果联系的线索，即「因果绕过」。研究在三种低层信号类型与八个语言模型上训练数百个内省器，发现常规 SFT 会诱发因果绕过，遂提出干预式训练:让模型报告反事实扰动后的信号值。该方法对内生信号与注入信号的内省都更准确，在分布外数据上尤为明显，且机制可跨 token 位置泛化并随数据量扩展。结果表明因果扎根的内省可以实现但并非必然，应训练机制而非仅训练行为。
arxiv.reason: LLM内省与可解释性训练方法，属后训练与机制理解交叉

arxiv.title: Structural-Test Geometry as an Inductive Bias for Partially Observable World Models
arxiv.abstract: Predictive world-model objectives need not organize latent histories according to distinctions required for later control. With privileged simulator access during training, should response-derived structural information be predicted, decoded, or imposed directly on latent geometry--and how do these choices compare with structured belief distillation? We define posterior-marginalized structural tests whose response distributions induce a pseudometric over histories, then train quotient-preserving (QP) world models by aligning shared latent Euclidean distances to that metric. Across a fixed six-task diagnostic suite, the largest differences appear under held-out structural variation: QP improves planning success by 26.1 points $[21.5,30.7]$ over metric decoding and 6.4 points $[3.8,9.0]$ over structured belief distillation. On GridWorld, metric decoding accurately recovers held-out structural distances ($ρ=.91$) while its native latent geometry remains more distorted than QP's (paired IQD difference $.22$ $[.20,.24]$), showing that relational recoverability and direct geometric alignment can diverge.
arxiv.titleZh: 结构测试几何作为部分可观测世界模型的归纳偏置
arxiv.summaryZh: 预测式世界模型的目标函数未必能让隐状态按后续控制所需的区分度组织。方法上先用后验边缘化的结构测试，由其响应分布诱导历史空间上的伪度量，再训练商保持(QP)世界模型，把共享隐空间的欧氏距离对齐到该度量。在固定六任务诊断集上，QP 在留出结构变化下比度量解码提升规划成功率 26.1 点[21.5,30.7]，比结构化信念蒸馏提升 6.4 点[3.8,9.0];在 GridWorld 上度量解码能较准确恢复留出结构距离(ρ=.91)，但其隐几何比 QP 更扭曲。该结果说明关系可恢复性与直接几何对齐可以分离，为世界模型隐空间设计提供依据。
arxiv.reason: 世界模型隐几何对齐，与LLM后训练方向擦边

arxiv.title: HEDGE: Gated Hypergraph Memory for Scalable Multi-Agent Debate
arxiv.abstract: Multi-agent debate systems require agents to retain and revisit arguments across multiple rounds, yet limited context windows and unstructured memories make relevant information increasingly difficult to recover. Existing flat and pairwise-graph memories also struggle to capture higher-order relations, including multi-agent agreement, conflicting evidence, and evolving consensus. We introduce HEDGE, a selective memory framework that represents debate trajectories as semantic hypergraphs. Hyperedges connect related claims across agents, while intra-hyperedge relational graphs preserve fine-grained argumentative structure. A learned memory selection module (MSM), trained through supervised learning and reinforcement learning, routes each memory candidate to STORE, BACKUP, or OMIT, retaining useful information while limiting redundancy. Across seven diverse benchmarks, HEDGE consistently outperforms strong single-agent, multi-agent, and memory baselines, improving accuracy by 5.0 points on average over the strongest multi-agent system with GPT-4o-mini. The gains reach 8.2 points on conflict-heavy tasks, while HEDGE reduces memory usage by 48% and the number of debate rounds by 34%.
arxiv.titleZh: HEDGE：面向可扩展多智能体辩论的门控超图记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体辩论需跨轮次保留并回溯论点，但有限上下文与非结构化记忆使相关信息难以调取，平坦记忆与成对图记忆也刻画不了多智能体共识、冲突证据等高阶关系。HEDGE 将辩论轨迹表示为语义超图：超边跨智能体连接相关主张，超边内部关系图保留细粒度论证结构；可学习记忆选择模块（MSM）经监督学习与强化学习训练，把每个记忆候选路由到 STORE、BACKUP 或 OMIT 以抑制冗余。在七个基准上一致优于强单智能体、多智能体与记忆基线，以 GPT-4o-mini 为基座时平均准确率较最强多智能体系统高 5.0 分，冲突密集任务上提升达 8.2 分，同时记忆占用降低 48%、辩论轮数减少 34%。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体辩论记忆结构改进，属 Agent 方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: Geometric Time Score Estimators: Bridging Self-Predictive Representations and Generative Occupancy Models For Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: In reinforcement learning (RL), temporal reasoning is essential for estimating the density of future outcomes under a policy's occupancy measure. While self-predictive representations have been a dominant paradigm for occupancy density estimation, we find that they yield surprisingly poor estimates. On the other hand, generative occupancy models can produce remarkably accurate samples from the occupancy measure. Yet, they cannot easily recover occupancy densities, limiting their use for control despite their expressivity. In this paper, we propose Geometric Time Score Estimators (GTSE), a framework that bridges the two paradigms by learning occupancy density estimators along probability paths. We analyze how GTSE implicitly induces better occupancy estimators through improved representation learning and show how to directly extract self-predictive representations from this framework. Through experiments across several locomotion and manipulation tasks, we show that GTSE improves performance over state-of-the-art methods by $2\times$ to $6\times$ in goal-conditioned RL settings, and that the representations learned using our framework transfer effectively to downstream RL tasks. Website: https://aravindvenu7.github.io/website/gtse/
arxiv.titleZh: 几何时间得分估计器：连接自预测表征与生成式占用模型以用于强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 在强化学习中，估计策略占用测度下未来结果的密度需要时序推理；自预测表征虽是主流范式，但其密度估计精度出奇地差，而生成式占用模型虽能准确采样，却难以恢复密度，因而不利于控制。GTSE 沿概率路径学习占用密度估计器，将这两类范式连接起来，并分析它如何通过改进表征学习间接获得更好的占用估计，同时给出从该框架直接抽取自预测表征的方法。在多个 locomotion 与 manipulation 任务上，目标条件 RL 的性能相比 SOTA 提升 2–6 倍，所学表征可有效迁移到下游 RL 任务。
arxiv.reason: 经典控制 RL 与机器人操作任务，属低分方向，仅与生成建模略沾边

arxiv.title: Aligning Autoresearch: Co-Improvement between Agents and Humans
arxiv.abstract: Autoresearch agents can now attempt long-horizon AI research end-to-end, i.e., self-improvement. However, best results are still obtained by research agents interacting with human researchers, and improving AI's ability to perform this co-research will only reinforce this effect---a process termed co-improvement (Weston and Foerster, 2025). Further, aligning with human expectations is likely a safer path for research agents, especially given recent agent reward hacking phenomena (OpenAI, 2026b). In this work we address these issues in four ways: (i) we empirically study the role of humans in directing autoresearch agents, focusing on the domain of benchmark creation, and find humans still play a pivotal role particularly in the ideation phase; (ii) we also develop a benchmark, HackBench, that shows current autoresearch agents are not aligned and are unable to achieve hack localization sufficiently; (iii) we present a method to train agents for improved human interaction by using human simulators as a proxy during reinforcement learning (RL); and finally (iv) we develop a method to improve model text generation, and hence agent communication, by RL with rubrics aligned with human experts. Together, our training and evaluation recipes provide a path toward more capable and aligned (co-)research agents.
arxiv.titleZh: 对齐自动科研:Agent 与人类的协同改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 自动科研 Agent 已能端到端推进长周期研究，但最佳成果仍来自 Agent 与人类研究者的协作，且存在奖励黑客风险。工作分四部分:在基准构建任务上实证人类在构思阶段的枢纽作用;提出 HackBench 表明当前 Agent 对齐不足、难以定位 hack;用人类模拟器作为代理在 RL 中训练 Agent 改进人机交互;并用与人类专家对齐的 rubric 做 RL 提升模型文本生成与沟通能力。该训练与评测配方指向更能干、更对齐的协同科研 Agent。
arxiv.reason: 自动科研 Agent 的 Agentic RL 与对齐，命中 Agent 与 AI for Research

arxiv.title: Auditable Belief Updates as a Missing Safety Layer for LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as cognitive interfaces that shape how users interpret evidence, communicate, and make decisions. As deployed systems become more multimodal, tool-using, and multi-agent, safety failures no longer arise only from isolated harmful outputs, but also from how agents update, store, and propagate epistemic commitments across retrieval, memory, tools, and peer communication. In this paper, we define belief as an engineering abstraction for evidence-based commitments that guide downstream action. Building on this view, we propose the Explicit Belief Multi-Agent System (EB-MAS), which externalizes belief states into a structured substrate, uses belief operators to propose candidate updates, and applies a Cognitive Firewall to bound or reject updates that are weakly evidenced but strongly driven by vulnerability cues. We also discuss the risk of group belief at the group level, including manufactured consensus, collusion, and cascading misinformation, and outline practical integration challenges around grounding, false positives, scalability, and ethical misuse. Therefore, scalable agent safety requires not only better output filtering or stronger base models, but also explicit interfaces for tracing, calibrating, and constraining belief revision at runtime.
arxiv.titleZh: 可审计的信念更新：LLM 驱动的多智能体系统缺失的安全层
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模态、工具化、多智能体部署下，安全失效不再只源于单点有害输出，也来自智能体在检索、记忆、工具与互通信中更新与传播的证据性承诺。把「信念」定义为引导下游行动的证据性承诺这一工程抽象，提出显式信念多智能体系统 EB-MAS:将信念状态外化为结构化基底，用信念算子提出候选更新，并以「认知防火墙」限制或拒绝证据薄弱却受脆弱性线索强驱动的更新;同时讨论群体层面的制造共识、合谋与级联错误信息风险，以及接地、误报、扩展性与伦理滥用等落地难题。主张可扩展的智能体安全除输出过滤与更强基座模型外，还需在运行时提供可追踪、可校准、可约束信念修正的显式接口。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体信念审计属 Agent 安全方向，但偏概念框架缺实证

arxiv.title: Where You Inject Matters: The Trust Region Effect in LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly adopted in long-horizon tasks and interact with diverse external environments. Despite their growing capabilities, these agents remain vulnerable to real-world attacks such as indirect prompt injections, which manipulate agents through malicious instructions embedded in external environments. While existing risk assessment work has primarily focused on the injection content, the effect of where an injection appears has not been systematically characterized. Studying injection placement requires agents to operate over longer-horizon tasks and interact with diverse environmental surfaces. Thus, we build three agentic testbeds spanning tool use, coding, and daily workflow domains with diverse injection surfaces. Holding the injection content fixed, we find that agent susceptibility varies across injection placements. We refer to this phenomenon as the trust region effect: agents implicitly assign different levels of trust to different regions of their environments. For example, an agent powered by GPT-5.4 follows an unsafe injection instruction placed in a repository documentation file (i.e., a README or TODO file) 2.6 times more often on average than the same instruction placed in a code or data file. Building upon this observation, we develop learning-based attackers that generate injection content and select better injection placements. Our approach demonstrates that both where an injection is placed and what content it contains can affect the strength of indirect prompt injection attacks. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic characterization for the effectiveness of different injection placements, spanning both coarse-grained environmental surfaces and fine-grained positions. The uneven trust that agents implicitly place across their environments provides important insights for future attack and defense design.
arxiv.titleZh: 注入位置至关重要：LLM Agent 中的信任域效应
arxiv.summaryZh: 间接提示注入的风险评估此前只关注注入内容，忽略了注入位置的作用。为此构建了覆盖工具使用、代码与日常流程的三个 agent 测试床，在固定注入内容的前提下只改变注入位置，发现 agent 对环境不同区域存在隐性信任差异，即信任域效应：由 GPT-5.4 驱动的 agent 对放在 README、TODO 等文档中的不安全指令的遵循率，平均是同一指令放在代码或数据文件中的 2.6 倍。进一步用学习型攻击者联合优化注入内容与位置，证明位置与内容共同决定攻击强度。该工作首次系统刻画了粗粒度环境面与细粒度位置上的注入有效性，为 agent 攻击与防御设计提供了位置维度的依据。
arxiv.reason: Agent 间接提示注入的系统性研究，三测试床加学习型攻击者，命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Contextual Embeddings Beyond the Gold Chunk
arxiv.abstract: Contextual embeddings represent chunks of a document with respect to the document's global context. These models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that a relevant document contains only a single relevant chunk. In this work, we argue that in real-world use cases a retriever should not only find answers spread over several chunks but also surface the evidence needed to verify them. To address this, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-context, a family of contextual embedding models trained by distilling graded chunk-level relevance from a query-aware context compression model. This removes the need for gold-chunk labels and makes the training targets independent of the chunking. We utilize a vision-language backbone for training and release pplx-embed-v2-context in 9B and 0.6B sizes with compatible embedding spaces. On the evaluation side, we introduce two benchmarks that label both the chunks that answer a query and the evidence needed to verify the answer. Context-bench is a controlled diagnostic, and Q2D-Chunk is built from real-world search queries. To encourage further research, we also publish Q2D-Chunk as a public leaderboard. Our 9B model sets a new state of the art on both benchmarks and ConTEB. We find that the visual retrieval capabilities of our 9B model transfer from its vision-language base model and propose to extend chunking to image inputs. We demonstrate that our models achieve state-of-the-art performance among dense retrievers on visual ViDoRe-V3 and that performance improves with granular image chunking.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越单一金标块的情境化嵌入
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对真实检索中答案常跨多个块、且需同时返回可验证证据的问题，提出pplx-embed-v2-context系列情境化嵌入模型：用查询感知的上下文压缩模型蒸馏分档块级相关性，摆脱金标块标签并使训练目标不依赖分块方式。采用视觉语言骨干，发布9B与0.6B兼容嵌入空间版本，并构建同时标注答案块与证据块的Context-bench和基于真实搜索查询的Q2D-Chunk基准。9B模型在两基准及ConTEB上取得新SOTA，并在ViDoRe-V3上验证视觉检索能力与细粒度图像分块收益。
arxiv.reason: RAG检索嵌入与基准工作，相关但非后训练/Agent核心

arxiv.title: Learning to Reason from Reference Samples Alone: Reinforced Adversarial Learning for Modern LLM Post-Training
arxiv.abstract: In many settings where LLM post-training is desirable, high-quality answers are recognizable but difficult to score with explicit rewards. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited to tasks where an explicit correctness signal is available. Prior adversarial approaches to training reasoning LLMs either complement verifiable rewards with co-trained critics or require reference reasoning traces. We ask whether a co-trained LLM judge can turn reference answers alone into the sole reward for on-policy post-training of reasoning LLMs. We call this method Reinforced Adversarial Learning (RAL). We first validate RAL on three verifiable tasks (integer multiplication, code-based arithmetic-expression synthesis, and SMILES-to-formula translation), using the verifiers only for evaluation. With sufficiently capable judges and enough training, RAL matches direct RLVR. We then apply RAL to scientific abstract generation in two settings. In the first setting, RAL guides the generator to produce abstracts in the scientific domain of the reference abstracts, even though the prompt leaves that domain unspecified. In the second setting, we generate abstracts for U.S. National Institutes of Health grant proposals conditioned on the grant title. Human scientists and an ensemble of LLM judges find our generations harder to distinguish from real abstracts than those of frontier-LLM baselines. These results suggest a path toward post-training reasoning models in scientific and other high-value domains, where increasingly capable judges infer hard-to-specify reward functions from example answers.
arxiv.comment: 31 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendices
arxiv.titleZh: 仅凭参考样本学习推理：面向现代LLM后训练的强化对抗学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决高质量答案可辨识却难以用显式奖励打分时的后训练问题。RAL用协同训练的LLM评判器把参考答案转化为唯一奖励信号，驱动on-policy强化学习。在整数乘法、代码算术表达式合成、SMILES到分子式翻译三个可验证任务上，RAL仅将验证器用于评估，训练充分且评判器足够强时可追平直接RLVR。进一步用于科学摘要生成，人类科学家和LLM评判器集合认为其生成比前沿LLM基线更难与真实摘要区分。
arxiv.reason: 用LLM评判器替代可验证奖励做后训练，直接命中RLVR与对齐方向

arxiv.title: Discovery of Diverse and Realistic Financial Tail-Risk Using Generative Flow Networks
arxiv.abstract: Accurate modeling of rare, high-impact financial events is essential for robust risk management. Sampling-based techniques such as Sequential Markov Chain Monte Carlo (SMCMC) generate diverse scenarios but inefficiently explore high-risk regions, while Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) converges on narrow sets of scenarios, limiting diversity. We present GRID, which uses Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) -- samplers that draw objects in proportion to a reward -- to systematically generate diverse and realistic financial tail-risk scenarios. Building on continuous GFlowNets, GRID introduces a flexible mixture-policy architecture with variable-specific distribution families for high-dimensional, sequential macro-financial data, together with plausibility constraints that keep generated trajectories realistic. A central practical advantage is robustness to reward-proxy imperfection: because GFlowNets sample proportionally rather than maximize, they remain broadly exploratory even when the oracle's out-of-sample accuracy is low -- an unavoidable reality in financial forecasting. On three real-world crises, GRID improves scenario diversity, realism, and tail-risk coverage over RL and MCMC baselines, and ablations over oracle architectures and distribution families yield practical insights into continuous GFlowNet behavior under noisy rewards.
arxiv.titleZh: 利用生成流网络发现多样化且逼真的金融尾部风险
arxiv.summaryZh: 金融尾部风险场景的生成长期在多样性与真实性之间失衡：SMCMC 采样多样但难以高效探索高风险区域，DRL 则收敛到狭窄场景集。GRID 将连续 GFlowNet 用于高维序列化宏观金融数据，引入按变量选择分布族的混合策略架构与合理性约束，使生成轨迹保持真实；由于 GFlowNet 按奖励比例采样而非取最大值，即使奖励代理的样本外精度较低仍能广泛探索。在三次真实金融危机上，GRID 在场景多样性、真实性与尾部风险覆盖上优于 RL 与 MCMC 基线，并通过 oracle 架构与分布族消融给出了噪声奖励下连续 GFlowNet 行为的实用结论。
arxiv.reason: GFlowNet 用于金融尾部风险生成，属垂直行业应用

arxiv.title: What to randomize matters: a controlled study of volume, axis and representation in low-data molecular generation
arxiv.abstract: Chemical language models can struggle to generate new molecules when trained on small datasets, where a model may reproduce training examples rather than learn a useful generative distribution. Randomized SMILES augmentation varies atom traversal, whereas Sequential Attachment-based Fragment Embedding (SAFE) also allows the order of fragment blocks to vary. How these distinct sources of representational variation affect low-data molecular generation has not been clearly studied. Here, using 1,000 seed molecules to train an autoregressive sequence model, we compare canonical SAFE with randomized SAFE at increasing corpus sizes, isolate atom-order and fragment-order axes of SAFE randomization, and compare fully randomized SAFE with randomized SMILES at molecule-by-molecule matched training corpora. Three findings emerge. First, randomization of SAFE alone raises the genuine yield of novel molecules more than 450-fold, turning a model that merely reproduces its training set into a practical molecular generator. Second, the two axes of randomization act jointly rather than additively: atom order alone reaches a tenth, and fragment order alone a seventh, of the genuine yield obtained when both vary, which is four times their combined contribution. Third, at matched corpus size and compute, randomized SAFE delivers 2.8 times the genuine yield of randomized SMILES. Welch tests with Games-Howell post-hoc comparisons resolve every difference on the primary outcomes. In the low-data regime, thus, what one randomizes rather than only how much determines whether augmentation produces new molecules or merely new spellings of the training set.
arxiv.titleZh: 随机化什么才重要：低数据分子生成中体积、轴与表示的控制变量研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 小数据下训练化学语言模型时，模型容易复述训练分子而非学会生成分布。以1000个种子分子训练自回归序列模型，系统比较规范SAFE与随机化SAFE，并拆解原子遍历顺序与片段顺序两个随机化轴，再与随机化SMILES在逐分子匹配的训练语料上对照。结果显示:仅随机化SAFE即把真实新分子的产出提升450倍以上;两个随机化轴为协同而非可加关系，单独原子顺序与单独片段顺序分别只达双轴同时随机化的约十分之一与七分之一;在语料与算力匹配时，随机化SAFE的真实产出为随机化SMILES的2.8倍。结论说明低数据生成中「随机化什么」比「随机化多少」更决定增强能否带来真正的新分子。
arxiv.reason: 分子生成属生物医药交叉，与LLM主线仅方法层面沾边

arxiv.title: Discovering Jailbreaks via Curriculum of Models
arxiv.abstract: Automated jailbreak discovery aims to find prompts that elicit prohibited behaviors from safety-trained language models, helping developers identify vulnerabilities before deployment. One class of approaches uses reinforcement learning to train an investigator model to generate prompts that elicit a specified behavior from a target model. However, training directly against a safety-trained target is difficult because nearly all prompts are refused, leaving the investigator with a sparse reward signal. Prior work addresses this with the propensity bound (PRBO), a proxy reward estimated by sampling responses from a more compliant target, and then adjusting for how likely those responses would have been under the original target. We introduce Curriculum of Models (CoM), an alternative method that trains the investigator against a sequence of modified versions of the target, progressing gradually from a version that readily exhibits the specified behavior to the original target. For jailbreak discovery, training begins against a target version that rarely refuses harmful requests, and advances to the next, harder version once the investigator reliably elicits the behavior from the current one. We evaluate CoM on elicitation tasks involving CBRN materials, explosives, and illicit drugs, using two open-weight targets, gemma-4-31b-it and gpt-oss-120b. We compare against PRBO and direct training on the original target without a curriculum. When the investigator is trained to elicit a single behavior, CoM finds successful jailbreaks more reliably than either baseline. When trained on multiple behaviors simultaneously, the CoM-trained investigator can elicit held-out behaviors, though PRBO-trained investigators achieve higher success rates. Our results suggest that a simple curriculum over target models offers a promising approach for addressing sparse rewards in rare-behavior elicitation.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过模型课程发现越狱
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对安全对齐模型的自动化越狱发现:直接对目标模型做RL训练时几乎所有提示都被拒答、奖励信号稀疏。提出模型课程(CoM)，把目标模型改造成一系列拒答程度递增的版本，调查模型先在几乎不拒答的版本上训练，能稳定诱发指定行为后再升级到更难版本，直至原始目标。在CBRN材料、爆炸物、非法药物诱发任务上，用gemma-4-31b-it与gpt-oss-120b评测:单行为设定下CoM比PRBO和无课程直接训练更可靠地找到越狱;多行为同时训练时可泛化到留出行为，但成功率低于PRBO。
arxiv.reason: 稀疏奖励下的课程式RL越狱发现，机制可迁移但属安全红队应用

arxiv.title: CopyLoop: Fast Looped Transformer Decoding via Context Copying and Shallow Screening
arxiv.abstract: Looped Transformers increase computational capacity through the repeated application of shared blocks, but their recurrent depth makes conventional full-depth decoding expensive. While existing speculative pipelines accelerate generation by processing consecutive token positions at varying depths, they are typically limited by sequential decoding overheads. We introduce CopyLoop, a training-free decoding algorithm that combines low-cost context-copy proposals with shallow screening and continuous recurrent scheduling. Rather than step-by-step generation, CopyLoop proposes multi-token suffixes from repeated context. It then evaluates them early at a shallow recurrent depth to efficiently filter out incorrect branches, processing newer blocks concurrently while earlier blocks are still progressing toward full-depth verification. We evaluate CopyLoop across six model checkpoints from the Ouro, Raven, and Huginn families, covering code generation and multi-step mathematical reasoning. CopyLoop achieves decoding speedups of 2.98x--10.70x over full-depth autoregressive decoding on Base models and 2.74x--3.52x on Thinking models, consistently outperforming or closely matching all competing baselines across evaluation tasks. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm a strong synergy between shallow screening and continuous scheduling, while our analyses show that CopyLoop requires only lightweight model calibration and yields greater speedups on longer generations with reusable contexts.
arxiv.titleZh: CopyLoop:通过上下文复制与浅层筛选实现循环Transformer的快速解码
arxiv.summaryZh: 循环Transformer靠重复应用共享块提升容量，但循环深度使全深度解码代价高昂。CopyLoop是免训练解码算法:从重复上下文中提出多token后缀草稿，先在浅层循环深度提前筛选错误分支，并让新块在旧块仍向全深度验证推进时并发处理，避免逐token顺序解码开销。在Ouro、Raven、Huginn六个checkpoint的代码生成与多步数学推理任务上，相对全深度自回归解码取得2.98x–10.70x加速(Base)与2.74x–3.52x(Thinking)，优于或接近全部基线。仅需轻量校准，长生成且上下文可复用场景收益更大，适合循环深度架构的推理部署。
arxiv.reason: 循环Transformer免训练投机解码，命中架构与推理加速方向

arxiv.title: Causal Attention on CPU: A Cache-Aware and Load-Balanced Scheduling Kernel for Prefill
arxiv.abstract: Agentic AI drives significant productivity gains across diverse domains, but concurrent long-context prefills from multiple agents can saturate GPU compute resources. Although CPUs offer a viable alternative, existing CPU attention kernels fall short in adapting to multi-tier cache hierarchies and lack effective thread scheduling. To address this, we introduce CACPU, a high-performance attention kernel featuring tiered cache blocking and an in-kernel task dispatching mechanism designed for causal full-sequence prefilling. CACPU achieves up to a 2.01x speedup over PyTorch SDPA, FlexAttention, and SGLang attention kernels. Integrated into SGLang, it reduces Time to First Token (TTFT) of Llama-3.1-8B by up to 1.74x while preserving model accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: CPU 上的因果注意力：面向 Prefill 的缓存感知与负载均衡调度内核
arxiv.summaryZh: 多 Agent 并发长上下文 prefill 会占满 GPU 算力，把因果全序列 prefill 的 attention 卸载到 CPU 是可行替代，但现有 CPU attention 内核难以适配多级 cache 层次、也缺乏有效的线程调度。CACPU 采用分层 cache 分块（tiered cache blocking）并配合内核内任务分发机制，实现负载均衡的因果 attention 计算。相比 PyTorch SDPA、FlexAttention 与 SGLang attention 内核最高取得 2.01x 加速，集成进 SGLang 后 Llama-3.1-8B 的首 token 时延（TTFT）最多降低 1.74x 且保持模型精度。适用于异构算力下长上下文推理服务的 prefill 卸载与调度。
arxiv.reason: CPU attention 内核优化，命中高效推理与 prefill 调度方向

arxiv.title: Routed Continual Learning
arxiv.abstract: Agents deployed at scale repeatedly encounter related problems, and it is natural to let them learn from each other's experience rather than starting over each time. Unfortunately, there is no single way to retain that experience that works well across settings, and no way to know in advance which future problems a given experience will help with. A global history preserves every detail but becomes expensive and mixes together experience that may not belong together; compressing that history into one fixed representation limits the cost but can throw away valuable details. We introduce Routed Continual Learning (Routed CL), an architecture that decides how to partition and retain experience. Past trajectories are grouped into clusters, each of which maintains state using one memory system from a fixed library. Before each run, an LLM-based router either reuses an existing cluster or creates a new one, basing its decision on the problem statement, memory system descriptions, and cluster summaries. We also introduce Context Memory Adapter, which mediates between the memory system and the agentic loop. We evaluate the architecture on a heterogeneous stream that interleaves 301 instances from the six CL-Bench tasks with 97 banking instances from $τ^3$-Bench. Across four language models and five matched rollouts, Routed Continual Learning raises normalized reward over a single global in-context learning (ICL) history by 15-30% of the maximum attainable normalized reward, achieves higher mean normalized reward than ICL-only clustering, and reduces estimated API cost by 65-72% relative to Global ICL. These results support approaching continual learning as a routing problem that chooses both a learning mechanism and a state cluster rather than committing to one representation globally.
arxiv.titleZh: 路由式持续学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对智能体在规模化部署中反复遇到相关问题、但单一记忆方案难以跨场景通用的问题，提出 Routed CL:把历史轨迹聚成簇，每簇从固定记忆系统库中选用一种记忆机制维护状态，运行前由 LLM 路由器依据问题陈述、记忆系统描述与簇摘要决定复用已有簇还是新建簇，并用 Context Memory Adapter 衔接记忆系统与智能体循环。在由 CL-Bench 六个任务共 301 个实例与 τ³-Bench 的 97 个银行实例交织成的异构流上，跨四个语言模型、五次匹配 rollout，归一化奖励比单一全局 ICL 历史提升可达最大值的 15–30%，优于仅做 ICL 的聚类方案，相对 Global ICL 估计 API 成本降低 65–72%。结果表明持续学习可视为同时选择学习机制与状态簇的路由问题。
arxiv.reason: Agent 记忆与持续学习，LLM 路由分簇，实验扎实

arxiv.title: Gold vs.~Translation: Are We Measuring Language, Knowledge, or Locality in Translated Benchmarks?
arxiv.abstract: Translated versions of English-origin benchmarks such as MMLU are widely used to evaluate large language models in non-English languages, yet it remains unclear whether they measure the same constructs as natively created benchmarks. We frame this as a proxy validity question and compare DeepL-translated MMLU proxies against six native benchmarks in seven pairings across five Nordic and Baltic languages, evaluating 29 models on each pairing. Beyond ranking agreement, we test incremental proxy validity: does the translated score add predictive value for native performance after controlling for model size and language proficiency? Proxy validity varies substantially across benchmark pairings. Applying the same robustness criteria to all seven pairings, we find four robust effects, two marginal effects, and one null result. The strongest evidence occurs for curriculum-overlap benchmarks such as Skolprov ($ΔR^2$=.128, 95% CI [.038,.253]), whereas translated MMLU provides no significant incremental value for Sweden-specific factual knowledge in SwedishFacts (p=.242). Because SwedishFacts is also the only open-ended benchmark, we cannot fully separate the effects of local content and response format. Overall, the results indicate a clear pattern: translated benchmarks provide a better proxy when their source content overlaps with the native evaluation target, while locally anchored knowledge is less reliably captured.
arxiv.titleZh: 金标准 vs. 翻译：我们在翻译基准中测量的究竟是语言、知识还是本地性？
arxiv.summaryZh: 翻译版基准（如MMLU）被广泛用于非英语评测，但其是否与原生基准测量同一构念仍不清楚。工作将问题框定为代理效度检验：把DeepL翻译的MMLU与六个原生基准在五种北欧与波罗的海语言上组成七组配对，每组评测29个模型；除排序一致性外，还检验增量代理效度，即在控制模型规模与语言能力后，翻译分数能否为原生表现提供额外预测力。七组配对中四个为稳健效应、两个边缘、一个零结果：课程内容重合的Skolprov最强（ΔR²=.128，95% CI [.038,.253]），而翻译MMLU对瑞典本地事实知识无显著增量（p=.242），提示源内容与评测目标重合时翻译基准才是可靠代理，本地化知识难以被替代。
arxiv.reason: 基准效度与评测可靠性方法学研究，正中评测方法学方向

arxiv.title: Loss is Not Behavior: A Unified Output-Space Analysis of Gradient-Based Machine Unlearning
arxiv.abstract: Gradient-based machine unlearning methods typically ``unlearn'' by optimizing forget and retain losses, but similar losses do not necessarily imply similar output-space behavior. Prior work has shown that high forget loss alone does not certify that unlearning has produced retraining-like output behavior. We therefore ask: when a gradient-based unlearner differs from the model that would have been learned on only the retain data, what structure does the resulting output-space gap have? We derive closed-form expressions for this gap in linear regression, with an extension to nonlinear models via a generalized Gauss-Newton and local linearity approximations. Our analysis puts various gradient-based methods under a unified framework parametrized by geometry, reweighting, and projection. Two leverage matrices emerge that capture the forget-retain entanglement under the retrained model geometry: forget self-leverage and retain cross-leverage. We show both theoretically and empirically that these two leverage matrices drive the impact of the forget residual on the forget and retain outputs, and existing methods account for this geometry only partially. Our framework yields precomputable leverage diagnostics for auditing forget sets to identify what type of gradient-based unlearning is likely to be successful.
arxiv.titleZh: Loss 不等于行为:基于梯度的机器遗忘的统一输出空间分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对基于梯度的机器遗忘通常只优化遗忘损失与保留损失、但损失接近并不意味着输出行为接近「仅用保留数据重训」模型的问题，在输出空间上给出该差距的闭式表达:线性回归下精确推导，并通过广义 Gauss-Newton 与局部线性近似推广到非线性模型。将各类梯度遗忘方法统一到由几何、重加权与投影三者参数化的框架中，指出遗忘-保留纠缠由两个杠杆矩阵刻画——遗忘自杠杆与保留交叉杠杆，理论与实验均表明二者决定遗忘残差对遗忘输出和保留输出的影响，而现有方法只部分地计入这一几何。由此得到可预计算的杠杆诊断量，可在遗忘前审计遗忘集、预判哪类梯度遗忘更可能成功。
arxiv.reason: 遗忘理论分析扎实，但与 LLM 后训练工程仅部分相关

arxiv.title: Skillful and realistic precipitation forecasting with reinforced diffusion
arxiv.abstract: Accurate precipitation forecasting remains elusive as physics-based models struggle to resolve mesoscale convection and machine learning often yields physically inconsistent, blurred results that consistently underestimate extreme events. We present FitzRoy, the first system that simultaneously achieves state-of-the-art predictive skill and physical realism over the continental United States. Through a reinforced diffusion framework, where a conditional discrete diffusion model is refined via reinforcement learning, FitzRoy effectively resolves the long-standing trade-off between pointwise accuracy and structural fidelity. Across lead times up to 24 hours, FitzRoy consistently matches or exceeds state-of-the-art models while preserving structural realism and capturing extreme events. Its low-latency inference further enables deployment in real-time operational settings. In case studies such as the 2025 Texas Hill Country floods and the 2026 Missouri floods, FitzRoy signals record-breaking accumulations that existing models largely missed. By bridging the gap between realism and skill, FitzRoy establishes a new frontier for high-fidelity precipitation forecasting.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于强化扩散的高技巧且逼真的降水预报
arxiv.summaryZh: 降水预报中，物理模型难以解析中尺度对流，而机器学习方法常产生物理上不一致的模糊结果并系统性低估极端事件。FitzRoy 以条件离散扩散模型为基础，通过强化学习对其进行精炼，形成强化扩散框架，从而同时兼顾逐点精度与结构保真度。在美国本土 24 小时以内各预报时效上，其预测技巧匹配或超过现有最优模型，并保留了结构真实性与极端事件，低延迟推理可支持实时业务部署;在 2025 年得州丘陵洪水和 2026 年密苏里洪水中，它捕捉到了现有模型普遍漏报的破纪录累积降水。
arxiv.reason: 扩散模型加气象垂直应用，双重落在低分方向
